context.en-US: SIRT7 ameliorates stress-induced cardiac hypertrophy by interacting with and deacetylating GATA4, a key cardiac transcription factor, modulating its target-gene program. Directionally, SIRT7 enzymatically regulates GATA4. This counters maladaptive hypertrophic signaling, and SIRT7-deficient mice display extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy. It is a nuclear mechanism by which SIRT7 protects the myocardium, complementing its nucleolar functions in ribosome biogenesis. The SIRT7-GATA4 interaction shows that SIRT7 controls cardiac gene expression through transcription-factor modification, and loss of this regulation contributes to pathological remodeling.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7 通過與 GATA4（一種關鍵的心臟轉錄因子）相互作用並去乙醯化它來改善壓力誘導的心臟肥大，調節其靶基因程序。在方向性上，SIRT7 在酶學上調節 GATA4。這對抗適應不良的肥大信號，SIRT7 缺乏的小鼠表現出廣泛的心肌纖維化和心肌病。這是 SIRT7 保護心肌的核內機制，與其在核糖體生物合成中的核仁功能互補。SIRT7-GATA4 相互作用表明 SIRT7 通過轉錄因子修飾控制心臟基因表達，此調節的缺失導致病理性重塑。

source_document: SIRT7.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: Activation of SIRT1, together with SIRT3, by resveratrol attenuates cardiac fibrosis in mice by inhibiting the TGF-β/Smad3 pathway. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of TGF-β/Smad3 suppression. This reduces collagen deposition and myofibroblast activation, preserving cardiac structure and function. It is a key antifibrotic mechanism relevant to heart and kidney disease, and it is consistent with SIRT1's ability to abolish TGF-β1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis and suppress CTGF expression. Because fibrosis is the common final pathway of organ injury, SIRT1 activation represents a broad antifibrotic strategy across tissues.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 與 SIRT3 一起被白藜蘆醇活化，通過抑制 TGF-β/Smad3 通路在小鼠中減輕心臟纖維化。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於 TGF-β/Smad3 抑制的上游。這減少膠原蛋白沉積和肌成纖維細胞活化，保留心臟結構和功能。這是與心臟和腎臟疾病相關的關鍵抗纖維化機制，與 SIRT1 消除 TGF-β1 誘導的凋亡和纖維化並抑制 CTGF 表達的能力一致。由於纖維化是器官損傷的共同最終通路，SIRT1 活化代表了一種跨組織的廣泛抗纖維化策略。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3, together with SIRT1, inhibits the TGF-β/Smad3 pathway to attenuate cardiac fibrosis in vivo. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of TGF-β/Smad3 blockade. This limits fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition and extracellular-matrix accumulation, preserving myocardial architecture. It complements SIRT3's general anti-inflammatory and metabolic cardiac protection, and SIRT3 deficiency promotes fibrotic responses, including in the aging lung. By restraining both oxidative stress and profibrotic signaling, SIRT3 provides multifactorial protection against organ fibrosis, supporting the therapeutic potential of SIRT3 activation in fibrotic disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 與 SIRT1 一起抑制 TGF-β/Smad3 通路，在體內減輕心臟纖維化。在方向性上，SIRT3 位於 TGF-β/Smad3 封鎖的上游。這限制成纖維細胞向肌成纖維細胞的轉化和細胞外基質的累積，保留心肌結構。它與 SIRT3 的一般抗發炎和代謝性心臟保護互補，SIRT3 缺乏促進纖維化反應，包括在衰老的肺中。通過同時限制氧化壓力和促纖維化信號，SIRT3 提供多因素保護對抗器官纖維化，支持 SIRT3 活化在纖維化疾病中的治療潛力。

source_document: SIRT3.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: Systemic SIRT6 knockout induces cardiac fibrosis in mice by activating the TGF-β/Smad3 pathway, so SIRT6 normally restrains this fibrogenic cascade. Directionally, SIRT6 loss activates TGF-β/Smad3, promoting fibrosis. This is the inverse of the protective relationship seen with SIRT1 and SIRT3, and it establishes SIRT6 as a cardiac antifibrotic factor. SIRT6 also prevents TGF-β1-induced lung myofibroblast differentiation, indicating broad antifibrotic action across organs. By suppressing Smad3 signaling and the myofibroblast program, SIRT6 protects tissues from the scarring that characterizes chronic injury and aging.
context.zh-TW: 全身性 SIRT6 敲除通過活化 TGF-β/Smad3 通路在小鼠中誘導心臟纖維化，因此 SIRT6 通常限制此纖維化級聯。在方向性上，SIRT6 的缺失活化 TGF-β/Smad3，促進纖維化。這與 SIRT1 和 SIRT3 所見的保護性關係相反，確立 SIRT6 為心臟抗纖維化因子。SIRT6 還防止 TGF-β1 誘導的肺肌成纖維細胞分化，表明跨器官的廣泛抗纖維化作用。通過抑制 Smad3 信號和肌成纖維細胞程序，SIRT6 保護組織免受慢性損傷和衰老特徵的瘢痕化。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: SIRT4

context.en-US: SIRT4 contributes to cardiac fibrosis; global SIRT4 knockout in mice confers resistance to angiotensin-II infusion by suppressing fibrotic deposition. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of profibrotic signaling. This aligns with SIRT4's general tendency to promote pathological remodeling, contrasting with the antifibrotic SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 members. SIRT4's profibrotic action likely reflects its inhibition of mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and promotion of oxidative stress. The opposing roles of SIRT4 versus the protective sirtuins in cardiac fibrosis illustrate the functional antagonism within the sirtuin family and the importance of the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
context.zh-TW: SIRT4 促進心臟纖維化；SIRT4 的全身敲除通過抑制纖維化沉積賦予對血管張力素 II 輸注的抗性。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於促纖維化信號的上游。這與 SIRT4 促進病理性重塑的總體趨勢一致，與抗纖維化的 SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 成員形成對比。SIRT4 的促纖維化作用可能反映其對粒線體氧化代謝的抑制和對氧化壓力的促進。SIRT4 與保護性 sirtuin 在心臟纖維化中的對立角色說明了 sirtuin 家族內的功能拮抗以及 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的重要性。

source_document: SIRT4.md

subject: SIRT7

context.en-US: Enhanced expression and phosphorylation of SIRT7 promotes cardiac fibrosis via activation of Smad2 and ERK signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of fibrogenic signaling. This reveals a pathological, profibrotic side of SIRT7 in the heart, contrasting with its nucleolar homeostatic roles and its protective actions against stress-induced hypertrophy. Thus SIRT7 can be maladaptive under stress despite protecting the myocardium in other settings, and its role in fibrosis depends on context, phosphorylation state, and the balance of its downstream effectors. SIRT7's dual cardiac roles illustrate the complexity of sirtuin signaling in disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7 的表達增強和磷酸化通過活化 Smad2 和 ERK 信號通路促進心臟纖維化。在方向性上，SIRT7 位於纖維化信號的上游。這揭示了 SIRT7 在心臟中的病理性、促纖維化面向，與其核仁穩態角色和對壓力誘導肥大的保護作用形成對比。因此 SIRT7 在壓力下可能是適應不良的，儘管在其他情境下保護心肌，其在纖維化中的作用取決於情境、磷酸化狀態及其下游效應因子的平衡。SIRT7 的雙重心臟角色說明了 sirtuin 信號在疾病中的複雜性。

source_document: SIRT7.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: Pharmacological activation of SIRT1 restores SERCA2a activity by deacetylating it at Lys492, improving calcium reuptake into the sarcoplasmic reticulum of cardiomyocytes. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically activates SERCA2a. Better SERCA2a function enhances calcium handling and contractility and opposes heart failure, where SERCA2a activity is depressed. This is a direct mechanism for SIRT1's cardioprotection, linking sirtuin activity to excitation-contraction coupling. By restoring SERCA2a-mediated calcium reuptake, SIRT1 activation improves diastolic function and reduces the arrhythmic and energetic burden of failing hearts.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 的藥理性活化通過在 Lys492 處去乙醯化 SERCA2a 來恢復其活性，改善心肌細胞肌質網對鈣離子的再攝取。在方向性上，SIRT1 在酶學上活化 SERCA2a。更好的 SERCA2a 功能增強鈣離子處理和收縮力，對抗心力衰竭（其中 SERCA2a 活性降低）。這是 SIRT1 心臟保護的直接機制，將 sirtuin 活性與興奮-收縮偶聯聯繫起來。通過恢復 SERCA2a 介導的鈣離子再攝取，SIRT1 活化改善舒張功能並降低衰竭心臟的心律失常和能量負擔。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 activation reduces lectin-like oxidized-LDL receptor-1 (Lox-1)-mediated foam cell formation by suppressing NF-κB signaling in vascular cells. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of inhibited Lox-1 scavenging of oxidized LDL. This limits macrophage lipid loading, a key early step in atherosclerosis, and reduces the inflammatory cascade triggered by ox-LDL uptake. It is a vascular anti-atherogenic action of SIRT1, complementing its activation of eNOS and its regulation of TIMP3. By restraining foam-cell formation, SIRT1 slows the development of atherosclerotic plaques in the vessel wall.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 活化通過抑制血管細胞中的 NF-κB 信號來減少凝集素樣氧化低密度脂蛋白受體-1（Lox-1）介導的泡沫細胞形成。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於被抑制的 Lox-1 對氧化低密度脂蛋白的清道夫作用上游。這限制巨噬細胞的脂質裝載（動脈粥樣硬化的關鍵早期步驟），並減少氧化低密度脂蛋白攝入觸發的發炎級聯。這是 SIRT1 的血管抗動脈粥樣硬化作用，與其對 eNOS 的活化和對 TIMP3 的調節互補。通過限制泡沫細胞形成，SIRT1 減緩血管壁中動脈粥樣硬化斑塊的發展。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT7

context.en-US: SIRT7 regulates vascular smooth-muscle cell (VSMC) proliferation and migration through the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway, limiting the neointimal hyperplasia that drives vascular disease. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of VSMC quiescence. By restraining VSMC activation, SIRT7 protects against atherosclerotic and restenotic remodeling after vascular injury. It adds a vascular-stability role to SIRT7, complementing its cardiac functions, and loss of SIRT7 permits excessive VSMC growth and migration. The Wnt/β-catenin pathway is a central driver of VSMC phenotypic switching, and SIRT7's regulation of it links sirtuins to vascular remodeling.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7 通過 Wnt/β-catenin 信號通路調節血管平滑肌細胞（VSMC）的增殖和遷移，限制驅動血管疾病的新生內膜增生。在方向性上，SIRT7 位於 VSMC 靜止的上游。通過限制 VSMC 活化，SIRT7 保護對抗血管損傷後的動脈粥樣硬化和再狹窄重塑。這為 SIRT7 增加了血管穩定性角色，與其心臟功能互補，SIRT7 的缺失允許過度的 VSMC 生長和遷移。Wnt/β-catenin 通路是 VSMC 表型轉換的中心驅動因子，SIRT7 對其的調節將 sirtuin 與血管重塑聯繫起來。

source_document: SIRT7.md

subject: MDL-800

context.en-US: MDL-800 is a bis-benzenesulfonamide prodrug and potent, selective SIRT6 activator, with an EC50 of 10.3 μM, that stimulates SIRT6 deacetylase activity. Directionally, MDL-800 allosterically activates SIRT6. It mirrors UBCS039 but with greater potency and cell permeability, mitigating kidney fibrosis and tumor glycolysis in preclinical models. It is a lead chemical tool for SIRT6 biology, and its improved potency and selectivity make it well suited for in vivo studies of SIRT6 activation, supporting the therapeutic potential of pharmacologic SIRT6 engagement.
context.zh-TW: MDL-800 是一種雙苯磺酰胺前藥和強效選擇性 SIRT6 活化因子，EC50 為 10.3 μM，刺激 SIRT6 去乙醯酶活性。在方向性上，MDL-800 變構活化 SIRT6。它類似於 UBCS039 但具有更高的效力和細胞滲透性，在臨床前模型中減輕腎纖維化和腫瘤糖解。它是 SIRT6 生物學的先導化學工具，其改善的效力和選擇性使其非常適合 SIRT6 活化的體內研究，支持藥理性 SIRT6 參與的治療潛力。

source_document: MDL-800.md

subject: EX-527 (Selisistat)

context.en-US: EX-527 (Selisistat) is the first known selective, cell-permeable SIRT1 inhibitor, with an IC50 of 0.098 μM and minimal activity against SIRT2 and SIRT3. Directionally, EX-527 blocks SIRT1 catalysis. It is used to dissect SIRT1-dependent phenotypes and was explored clinically for Huntington's disease, where SIRT1 inhibition was hypothesized to be beneficial. As a SIRT1 blocker, its effects contrast with those of STACs such as resveratrol, and it remains the standard tool for confirming whether a cellular effect depends on SIRT1 enzymatic activity rather than other targets.
context.zh-TW: EX-527（Selisistat）是第一個已知的選擇性、細胞可滲透的 SIRT1 抑制劑，IC50 為 0.098 μM，對 SIRT2 和 SIRT3 活性極小。在方向性上，EX-527 阻斷 SIRT1 催化。它用於解析 SIRT1 依賴性表型，並曾在亨丁頓症的臨床探索中被研究，其中假設 SIRT1 抑制是有益的。作為 SIRT1 阻斷劑，其效應與 STACs（如白藜蘆醇）相反，它至今仍是確認細胞效應是否依賴 SIRT1 酶活性而非其他靶點的標準工具。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SirReal2

context.en-US: SirReal2 is a potent SIRT2 inhibitor, with an IC50 of 0.14 μM and minimal effects on SIRT1 and SIRT3, exploiting a SIRT2-specific binding pocket. Directionally, SirReal2 blocks SIRT2 deacetylase activity. It is a key chemical probe for SIRT2 biology in neurodegeneration and cancer, and its selectivity makes it valuable for isolating SIRT2-specific effects from the broader sirtuin family. Because SIRT2 inhibition protects neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's models, SirReal2's selectivity positions it as a candidate scaffold for therapeutic development in neurodegenerative disease.
context.zh-TW: SirReal2 是一種強效的 SIRT2 抑制劑，IC50 為 0.14 μM，對 SIRT1 和 SIRT3 影響極小，利用 SIRT2 特異性結合口袋。在方向性上，SirReal2 阻斷 SIRT2 去乙醯酶活性。它是神經退行性疾病和癌症中 SIRT2 生物學的關鍵化學探針，其選擇性使其在區分 SIRT2 特異性效應與更廣泛 sirtuin 家族時具有價值。由於 SIRT2 抑制在帕金森症和亨丁頓症模型中保護神經元，SirReal2 的選擇性使其定位為神經退行性疾病治療開發的候選骨架。

source_document: SirReal2.md

subject: Suramin

context.en-US: Suramin, a polyanionic urea derivative, inhibits sirtuins with IC50 values of approximately 297 nM, 1150 nM, and 22 μM for SIRT1, SIRT2, and SIRT5 respectively, showing relative selectivity for SIRT5 at higher concentrations. Directionally, suramin blocks sirtuin catalysis. Its broad activity limits specificity, but it remains a tool to probe SIRT5, and it has also been studied as a therapeutic agent. Clinically, suramin is an antiparasitic and anticancer drug with off-target sirtuin effects, and understanding its sirtuin inhibition informs both its pharmacology and the design of more selective inhibitors.
context.zh-TW: Suramin 是一種聚陰離子脲衍生物，對 sirtuin 的 IC50 值分別約為 SIRT1 297 nM、SIRT2 1150 nM 和 SIRT5 22 μM，在較高濃度下對 SIRT5 顯示相對選擇性。在方向性上，suramin 阻斷 sirtuin 催化。其廣泛活性限制了特異性，但它仍然是探測 SIRT5 的工具，也被作為治療劑進行研究。在臨床上，suramin 是一種抗寄生蟲和抗癌藥物，具有脫靶 sirtuin 效應，了解其 sirtuin 抑制為其藥理學和更選擇性抑制劑的設計提供了資訊。

source_document: SIRT5.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: Overexpression of SIRT1 abolishes TGF-β1-induced apoptosis and fibrosis and suppresses CTGF expression in mouse kidney, protecting renal tissue from TGF-β1 insult. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of suppressed TGF-β1 pathology. This renoprotective action operates via deacetylation of TGF-β pathway components, including the promotion of Smad7 degradation that tempers TGF-β signaling in glomerular cells. It supports SIRT1 activation as a strategy against kidney fibrosis, and it is consistent with SIRT1's broader antifibrotic effects in heart and lung. Preserving SIRT1 in the kidney may slow the progression of chronic kidney disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 過量表達消除 TGF-β1 誘導的凋亡和纖維化，並在小鼠腎臟中抑制 CTGF 表達，保護腎組織免受 TGF-β1 損傷。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於被抑制的 TGF-β1 病理上游。這種腎保護作用通過 TGF-β 通路組分的去乙醯化運作，包括促進 Smad7 降解以調節腎小球細胞中的 TGF-β 信號。它支持 SIRT1 活化作為對抗腎纖維化的策略，與 SIRT1 在心臟和肺中的更廣泛抗纖維化效應一致。在腎臟中保留 SIRT1 可能減緩慢性腎病的進展。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: Genetic knockdown and chemical inhibition of SIRT2 attenuate TGF-β1-induced fibroblast activation and MDM2 expression, reducing fibrogenic responses. Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition leads to less TGF-β1 fibroblast activation. This is unusual because it implies SIRT2 can promote, rather than suppress, fibrosis in this context, unlike the antifibrotic SIRT1, SIRT3, and SIRT6. It underscores the context-dependence of sirtuin-fibrosis relationships and suggests that SIRT2 inhibition might be antifibrotic in specific settings. The MDM2 connection links SIRT2 to p53 regulation during fibroblast activation, adding mechanistic depth to the observation.
context.zh-TW: 基因敲低和化學抑制 SIRT2 減弱 TGF-β1 誘導的纖維母細胞活化和 MDM2 表達，減少纖維化反應。在方向性上，SIRT2 抑制導致較少的 TGF-β1 纖維母細胞活化。這是不尋常的，因為它暗示 SIRT2 在此情境下可以促進而非抑制纖維化，不同於抗纖維化的 SIRT1、SIRT3 和 SIRT6。它強調了 sirtuin-纖維化關係的情境依賴性，並提示 SIRT2 抑制可能在特定環境中具有抗纖維化作用。MDM2 的聯繫將 SIRT2 與纖維母細胞活化期間的 p53 調節聯繫起來，為觀察結果增加了機制深度。

source_document: SIRT2.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Pyruvate dehydrogenase E1α (PDH E1α) becomes hyperacetylated at Lys385 in tubular epithelial cells after TGF-β1 stimulation and is deacetylated by SIRT3, modulating pyruvate entry into the TCA cycle. Directionally, SIRT3 enzymatically activates PDH. This links mitochondrial metabolism to TGF-β1-driven kidney injury, and loss of SIRT3 leads to PDH hyperacetylation, reduced glucose oxidation, and pyruvate/lactate accumulation. It shows SIRT3 buffering metabolic dysfunction during fibrosis, and connects the metabolic phenotype of injured kidneys to sirtuin-dependent control of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex.
context.zh-TW: 丙酮酸脫氫酶 E1α（PDH E1α）在 TGF-β1 刺激後在腎小管上皮細胞中 Lys385 處被超乙醯化，並被 SIRT3 去乙醯化，調節丙酮酸進入 TCA 循環。在方向性上，SIRT3 在酶學上活化 PDH。這將粒線體代謝與 TGF-β1 驅動的腎損傷聯繫起來，SIRT3 的缺失導致 PDH 超乙醯化、葡萄糖氧化減少和丙酮酸/乳酸累積。它表明 SIRT3 在纖維化期間緩衝代謝功能障礙，並將受損腎臟的代謝表型與丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體的 sirtuin 依賴性控制聯繫起來。

source_document: SIRT3.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: SIRT6 suppresses osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth-muscle cells via repression of runt-related transcription factor 2 (Runx2), limiting vascular calcification. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of inhibited VSMC osteogenesis. This protects against vessel stiffening in atherosclerosis and aging, and it is a vascular-homeostasis function of SIRT6. By preventing VSMCs from adopting an osteoblast-like phenotype, SIRT6 preserves arterial compliance and reduces the calcific burden of aged vessels. The mechanism complements SIRT6's inhibition of NF-κB and inflammatory gene programs in the vasculature.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 通過抑制矮小相關轉錄因子 2（Runx2）來抑制血管平滑肌細胞的成骨轉分化，限制血管鈣化。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於被抑制的 VSMC 骨生成的上游。這保護對抗動脈粥樣硬化和衰老中的血管僵硬，是 SIRT6 的血管穩態功能。通過防止 VSMC 採取類骨母細胞的表型，SIRT6 保留動脈順應性並減少老化血管的鈣化負擔。此機制與 SIRT6 在血管中抑制 NF-κB 和發炎基因程序互補。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: MDL-800
object: UUO-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis

context.en-US: The SIRT6 activator MDL-800 mitigates unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO)-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis, validating SIRT6 activation therapeutically. Directionally, MDL-800 activates SIRT6, which protects the kidney. This complements other evidence that SIRT6 restrains TGF-β/Smad3 fibrogenesis and NF-κB-mediated inflammation. It supports SIRT6 as a target for chronic kidney disease, where tubulointerstitial fibrosis determines outcome. The efficacy of a pharmacologic SIRT6 activator in a standard fibrosis model provides important proof-of-concept for SIRT6-based therapies in renal and fibrotic disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 活化因子 MDL-800 減輕單側輸尿管阻塞（UUO）誘導的腎小管間質發炎和纖維化，在治療上驗證了 SIRT6 活化。在方向性上，MDL-800 活化 SIRT6，SIRT6 保護腎臟。這與 SIRT6 限制 TGF-β/Smad3 纖維化和 NF-κB 介導發炎的其他證據互補。它支持 SIRT6 作為慢性腎病的靶點，在該疾病中小管間質纖維化決定預後。藥理性 SIRT6 活化因子在標準纖維化模型中的療效為基於 SIRT6 的腎臟和纖維化疾病療法提供了重要的概念驗證。

source_document: MDL-800.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 in dendritic cells modulates the balance between pro-inflammatory Th1 and anti-inflammatory Foxp3+ regulatory T (Treg) cells; its knockout restrains Treg generation. Directionally, DC SIRT1 sits upstream of Treg differentiation. This shapes peripheral tolerance and limits autoimmunity, and DC-specific SIRT1 loss drives Th1 polarization and promotes inflammation. It links sirtuins to immune homeostasis beyond metabolism, showing that SIRT1 activity in antigen-presenting cells influences the outcome of T-cell responses. This immunoregulatory role is relevant to autoimmune disease, where tipping the balance toward Tregs is protective.
context.zh-TW: 樹突細胞中的 SIRT1 調節促發炎 Th1 和抗發炎 Foxp3+ 調節性 T（Treg）細胞之間的平衡；其敲除限制 Treg 生成。在方向性上，DC SIRT1 位於 Treg 分化的上游。這塑造周邊耐受並限制自體免疫，DC 特異性 SIRT1 的缺失驅動 Th1 偏向並促進發炎。這將 sirtuin 與超越代謝的免疫穩態聯繫起來，表明抗原呈遞細胞中的 SIRT1 活性影響 T 細胞反應的結果。這種免疫調節角色與自體免疫疾病相關，在這些疾病中平衡向 Treg 偏向具有保護作用。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: Dendritic-cell SIRT1 knockout drives T helper 1 (Th1) cell development and promotes inflammation, indicating SIRT1 normally restrains Th1 polarization. Directionally, DC SIRT1 sits upstream of suppressed Th1 differentiation. This tempers cell-mediated inflammatory responses and promotes regulatory T-cell generation, shaping the balance between immunity and tolerance. It demonstrates SIRT1's immunoregulatory role in antigen presentation and is relevant to autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, where excessive Th1 responses drive pathology. The effect likely reflects SIRT1-dependent control of cytokine and costimulatory molecule expression in dendritic cells.
context.zh-TW: 樹突細胞 SIRT1 敲除驅動輔助性 T 1（Th1）細胞發展並促進發炎，表明 SIRT1 通常限制 Th1 偏向。在方向性上，DC SIRT1 位於被抑制的 Th1 分化的上游。這調節細胞介導的發炎反應並促進調節性 T 細胞生成，塑造免疫和耐受之間的平衡。它展示了 SIRT1 在抗原呈遞中的免疫調節角色，與自體免疫和發炎性疾病相關，在這些疾病中過度的 Th1 反應驅動病理。此效應可能反映了 SIRT1 依賴性控制樹突細胞中細胞因子和共刺激分子表達。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT6 deficiency (macrophages)

context.en-US: SIRT6 deficiency in macrophages increases acetylation and stability of FoxO1, leading to sustained FoxO1 protein and an inflammatory state. Directionally, SIRT6 loss leads to hyperacetylated, stabilized FoxO1. Because SIRT6 normally deacetylates FoxO1, its absence prolongs FoxO1 signaling and promotes inflammatory gene expression in macrophages. This reveals a macrophage-intrinsic mechanism linking SIRT6 to inflammation resolution, and it is relevant to atherosclerosis, where macrophage inflammation drives plaque progression. SIRT6's control of FoxO1 stability adds to its chromatin-based regulation of inflammatory genes.
context.zh-TW: 巨噬細胞中 SIRT6 的缺乏增加 FoxO1 的乙醯化和穩定性，導致持續的 FoxO1 蛋白和發炎狀態。在方向性上，SIRT6 的缺失導致超乙醯化的、穩定的 FoxO1。由於 SIRT6 通常去乙醯化 FoxO1，其缺失延長 FoxO1 信號並促進巨噬細胞中的發炎基因表達。這揭示了一種巨噬細胞固有機制，將 SIRT6 與發炎消退聯繫起來，與動脈粥樣硬化相關（其中巨噬細胞發炎驅動斑塊進展）。SIRT6 對 FoxO1 穩定性的控制增加了其基於染色質的發炎基因調節。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: SIRT6 deacetylates FoxO1 and subsequently increases expression of glucose-dependent transporter 2 (GLUT2) in pancreatic β-cells. Directionally, SIRT6 activates FoxO1, which induces GLUT2. Higher GLUT2 restores glucose sensing and appropriate insulin release, maintaining systemic glucose tolerance. This complements SIRT6's role in β-cell metabolic health and its repression of TXNIP to preserve insulin secretion. By supporting β-cell identity and function, SIRT6 protects against the β-cell failure that characterizes type 2 diabetes, and its actions in β-cells illustrate how a nuclear sirtuin controls nutrient sensing.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 FoxO1，隨後在胰腺 β 細胞中增加葡萄糖依賴性轉運蛋白 2（GLUT2）的表達。在方向性上，SIRT6 活化 FoxO1，FoxO1 再誘導 GLUT2。更高的 GLUT2 恢復葡萄糖感知和適當的胰島素釋放，維持全身葡萄糖耐量。這與 SIRT6 在 β 細胞代謝健康中的作用及其抑制 TXNIP 以保留胰島素分泌互補。通過支持 β 細胞特性和功能，SIRT6 保護對抗 2 型糖尿病特徵的 β 細胞衰竭，其在 β 細胞中的作用說明了一種核內 sirtuin 如何控制營養感知。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: SIRT5

context.en-US: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation and lipid deposition by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of suppressed adipogenesis. This keeps progenitors from becoming lipid-laden fat cells and positions mitochondrial SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat accumulation. The AMPK arm likely raises NAD+ and reinforces catabolic metabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the mitogenic signaling required for adipocyte maturation. SIRT5's anti-adipogenic function is consistent with the sirtuin family's general opposition to lipid storage and its promotion of oxidative metabolism.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5 通過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 信號通路來抑制前脂肪細胞分化和脂質沉積。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於被抑制的脂肪生成的上游。這防止前體細胞成為富含脂質的脂肪細胞，將粒線體 SIRT5 定位為脂肪累積的負調節因子。AMPK 分支可能提高 NAD+ 並強化分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的促有絲分裂信號。SIRT5 的抗脂肪生成功能與 sirtuin 家族對脂質儲存的一般反對和對氧化代謝的促進一致。

source_document: SIRT5.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 directly binds the 3'UTR of transcription factor EB (TFEB) and enhances its mRNA stability, raising TFEB protein availability. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of stabilized TFEB message. TFEB then drives lysosomal and autophagic gene programs, so SIRT2 promotes autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis through this post-transcriptional mechanism. This reveals an RNA-binding facet of SIRT2's regulation of autophagy, distinct from its enzymatic deacetylation of other substrates. By stabilizing TFEB mRNA, SIRT2 supports cellular clearance of damaged components, linking sirtuin activity to lysosomal quality control.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 直接結合轉錄因子 EB（TFEB）的 3'UTR 並增強其 mRNA 穩定性，提高 TFEB 蛋白質的可用量。在方向性上，SIRT2 位於穩定化的 TFEB 訊息上游。TFEB 隨後驅動溶酶體和自噬基因程式，因此 SIRT5 透過此轉錄後機制促進自噬和溶酶體生物合成。這揭示了 SIRT2 調控自噬的一個 RNA 結合面向，有別於其對其他底物的酶性去乙醯化作用。透過穩定 TFEB mRNA，SIRT2 支持細胞清除受損組件，將 sirtuin 活性與溶酶體品質控制聯繫起來。

source_document: SIRT2.md

subject: TFEB

context.en-US: TFEB is a master transcription factor for lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy that plays a critical role in autophagosome-lysosome fusion and clearance of cargo. Directionally, TFEB sits upstream of autophagic-lysosomal execution. Because SIRT2 stabilizes TFEB mRNA and SIRT1 deacetylates TFEB to promote its nuclear translocation, sirtuins influence TFEB function through multiple mechanisms. This links sirtuins to the terminal degradative step of autophagy, and TFEB's transcriptional program, known as CLEAR, coordinates the lysosomal and autophagic machinery that clears damaged proteins and organelles during stress.
context.zh-TW: TFEB 是溶酶體生物合成和自噬的主控轉錄因子，在自噬溶酶體融合和清除負載物中扮演關鍵角色。在方向性上，TFEB 位於自噬溶酶體執行步驟的上游。由於 SIRT2 穩定 TFEB mRNA，而 SIRT1 去乙醯化 TFEB 以促進其核轉位，sirtuin 透過多種機制影響 TFEB 功能。這將 sirtuin 與自噬的終末降解步驟聯繫起來，而 TFEB 的轉錄程式——稱為 CLEAR——協調溶酶體和自噬機制，以在壓力期間清除受損蛋白質和細胞器。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT5

context.en-US: SIRT5-induced deacetylation of lactate dehydrogenase B (LDHB) triggers hyperactivation of autophagy, a process implicated in tumorigenesis. Directionally, SIRT5 modifies LDHB, which promotes autophagic hyperactivation. This connects mitochondrial acyl-metabolism control to lysosomal clearance, and the net effect can be context-dependent in cancer biology, supporting tumor-cell fitness under stress in some settings while potentially contributing to cell death in others. SIRT5's regulation of LDHB, a key enzyme of lactate metabolism, links metabolic enzymes to the autophagic program and illustrates the broad substrate repertoire of the desuccinylase.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5 誘導的乳酸脫氫酶 B（LDHB）去乙醯化觸發自噬過度活化，此過程與腫瘤發生有關。在方向性上，SIRT5 修飾 LDHB，進而促進自噬過度活化。這將粒線體醯基代謝控制與溶酶體清除聯繫起來，淨效應可能因癌症生物學的情境而異，在某些情況下支持腫瘤細胞在壓力下的適應性，而在其他情況下可能促進細胞死亡。SIRT5 對乳酸代謝關鍵酶 LDHB 的調控將代謝酶與自噬程式聯繫起來，並展現了去琥珀醯酶的廣泛底物譜。

source_document: SIRT5.md

subject: SIRT5-mediated deacetylation of LDHB

context.en-US: Deacetylation of LDHB by SIRT5 hyperactivates autophagy, accelerating cellular self-digestion and influencing tumor cell survival and metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5-mediated LDHB deacetylation sits upstream of autophagic hyperactivation. This can support tumor-cell fitness under stress by recycling nutrients, but it may also provoke cell-death programs when excessive. It exemplifies SIRT5's role at the autophagy-metabolism interface, where the same enzyme coordinates both fuel utilization and the clearance of cellular components. Understanding this axis is relevant to cancer therapy, where modulating autophagy can either sensitize or protect tumor cells.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化使自噬過度活化，加速細胞自我消化並影響腫瘤細胞的存活和代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 介導的 LDHB 去乙醯化位於自噬過度活化的上游。這可以透過回收營養物質在壓力下支持腫瘤細胞的適應性，但當過度活化時也可能引發細胞死亡程式。這體現了 SIRT5 在自噬—代謝交界處的角色，同一種酶同時協調燃料利用和細胞組件的清除。理解這一軸線與癌症治療相關，因為調控自噬可以增敏或保護腫瘤細胞。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: SIRT6 deacetylates histone H3K9 at the promoters of Nkx3.2 and related genes, thereby inhibiting Nkx3.2 transcription. Because Nkx3.2 is itself a repressor of GATA5, this double-negative cascade derepresses GATA5 to prevent endothelial injury and balances vascular protective gene programs. SIRT6 also regulates downstream targets including ERK1/2 through similar H3K9 deacetylation at their promoters, acting as a locus-specific transcriptional regulator. By removing the H3K9ac mark at these loci, SIRT6 silences genes that would otherwise promote pathological programs, a chromatin-based mechanism central to SIRT6's control of endothelial and cardiovascular homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 Nkx3.2 及相關基因啟動子上的組蛋白 H3K9，從而抑制 Nkx3.2 的轉錄。由於 Nkx3.2 本身是 GATA5 的抑制因子，此雙重否定級聯反應解除對 GATA5 的抑制，以防止內皮損傷並平衡血管保護性基因程式。SIRT6 也透過在 ERK1/2 等下游靶基因啟動子上類似的 H3K9 去乙醯化作用來調控其表達，作為位點特異性的轉錄調節因子。透過在這些基因座上去除 H3K9ac 標記，SIRT6 沉默了原本會促進病理程式的基因，這是一種基於染色質的機制，對 SIRT6 控制內皮和心血管恆定性至關重要。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: SIRT6 induces expression of GATA-binding protein 5 (GATA5) by deacetylating H3K9 at the Nkx3.2 promoter, preventing endothelial injury. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of GATA5 induction. GATA5 supports endothelial integrity and opposes dysfunction, and its induction by SIRT6 protects the vasculature from injury. This is a vascular-protective transcriptional output of SIRT6, achieved through repression of the Nkx3.2 repressor. The SIRT6-Nkx3.2-GATA5 axis exemplifies how SIRT6 controls downstream genes through cascades of transcription factors, and it connects epigenetic regulation to endothelial function and vascular disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 透過在 Nkx3.2 啟動子上去乙醯化 H3K9 誘導 GATA 結合蛋白 5（GATA5）的表達，從而防止內皮損傷。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 GATA5 誘導的上游。GATA5 支持內皮完整性並對抗功能障礙，其被 SIRT6 誘導可保護血管免受損傷。這是 SIRT6 的血管保護性轉錄輸出，透過抑制抑制因子 Nkx3.2 而實現。SIRT6-Nkx3.2-GATA5 軸線示範了 SIRT6 如何透過轉錄因子的級聯反應控制下游基因，並將表觀遺傳調控與內皮功能和血管疾病聯繫起來。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at ERK1/2 gene promoters, inhibiting ERK1/2 expression and thereby dampening pro-hypertrophic MAPK signaling. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of ERK1/2 suppression. Reduced ERK signaling limits growth and fibrotic responses in the heart and vasculature, and it adds a MAPK-regulatory dimension to SIRT6's cardiovascular protection. By directly controlling the expression of the ERK1/2 genes themselves, rather than only their activity, SIRT6 provides sustained restraint of this pro-growth pathway, complementing its inhibition of IGF-Akt signaling in cardiac hypertrophy.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 在 ERK1/2 基因啟動子上去乙醯化 H3K9，抑制 ERK1/2 的表達，從而抑制促肥大的 MAPK 訊號。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 ERK1/2 抑制的上游。減少的 ERK 訊號限制了心臟和血管中的生長和纖維化反應，並為 SIRT6 的心血管保護增添了 MAPK 調節維度。透過直接控制 ERK1/2 基因本身的表達（而不僅僅是其活性），SIRT6 對此促生長通路提供了持久的抑制，與其在心臟肥大中抑制 IGF-Akt 訊號的作用互補。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol is the polyphenolic stilbene 3,4',5-trihydroxystilbene, a plant defensive compound produced under stress such as pathogen attack or UV exposure. Its chemical structure features three phenolic hydroxyls that confer redox activity and enable binding to sirtuin and phosphodiesterase targets. Directionally, resveratrol acts as the small-molecule upstream activator of SIRT1. Though a weak direct antioxidant compared with vitamin C or cysteine, its biological impact flows mainly through signaling modulation—activating SIRT1, AMPK, and eNOS, and inhibiting PDE4—rather than through stoichiometric scavenging of free radicals.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol（白藜蘆醇）是多酚類芪類化合物 3,4',5-三羥基芪，一種在病原體侵襲或紫外線照射等壓力下產生的植物防禦化合物。其化學結構具有三個酚羥基，賦予其氧化還原活性並使其能夠結合 sirtuin 和磷酸二酯酶靶標。在方向性上，resveratrol 作為 SIRT1 的小分子上游活化劑。儘管作為直接抗氧化劑其效力弱於維生素 C 或半胱氨酸，但其生物學影響主要透過訊號調制實現——活化 SIRT1、AMPK 和 eNOS，並抑制 PDE4——而非透過化學計量自由基清除。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol is found concentrated in grape skins, where it contributes to the anti-atherosclerotic benefits attributed to red wine consumption. Directionally, dietary resveratrol sits upstream of vascular protection. Skin content is modest and matrix-dependent, influencing how much reaches circulation, and typical red wine contains 1.5-3 mg/L, so a single glass provides only about 0.3 mg. This botanical source motivated the French-paradox hypothesis, and the presence of resveratrol in the skin rather than the flesh explains why wine, not grape juice, carries most of the compound.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 在葡萄皮中濃度較高，有助於歸因於飲用紅酒的抗動脈粥樣硬化益處。在方向性上，飲食中的 resveratrol 位於血管保護的上游。皮中的含量有限且受基質影響，影響其進入循環的量，典型紅酒含有 1.5-3 mg/L，因此一杯酒僅提供約 0.3 mg。這種植物來源催生了法國悖論假說，而 resveratrol 存在於果皮而非果肉中，解釋了為何葡萄酒而非葡萄汁攜帶大部分此化合物。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol-containing plants such as Veratrum formosanum have long been used in traditional East Asian medicine, foreshadowing modern interest in the compound. Directionally, the traditional botanical use precedes and motivates contemporary pharmacological study. This ethnobotanical precedent parallels other stilbene-bearing remedies, and it contributed to the identification of resveratrol as a bioactive compound with cardiovascular and longevity-associated properties. It is historical context rather than a mechanistic claim, but it illustrates how traditional medicine has repeatedly pointed modern pharmacology toward bioactive natural products.
context.zh-TW: 含 resveratrol 的植物如台灣藜蘆（Veratrum formosanum）長期以來被用於傳統東亞醫學，預示了現代對此化合物的興趣。在方向性上，傳統植物使用先於並推動了當代藥理學研究。這種民族植物學先例與其他含芪類的藥方相似，並促進了 resveratrol 作為具有心血管和壽命相關特性的活性化合物的鑑定。這是歷史背景而非機制性主張，但它說明了傳統醫學如何一再指引現代藥理學發現活性天然產物。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol protects endothelial cells from lipid (e.g., oxidized-LDL) damage, helping preserve vascular barrier and nitric-oxide function. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of endothelial protection. This action is mediated through SIRT1/eNOS and antioxidant pathways, reducing the injurious effects of oxidized lipoproteins on the endothelium. It is a foundational vascular benefit supporting resveratrol's cardiovascular reputation, and it is consistent with resveratrol's inhibition of Lox-1-mediated foam-cell formation and its promotion of vasodilation. Preserving endothelial integrity is central to preventing the initiation and progression of atherosclerosis.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 保護內皮細胞免受脂質（如氧化型 LDL）損傷，有助於維護血管屏障和一氧化氮功能。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於內皮保護的上游。此作用透過 SIRT1/eNOS 和抗氧化途徑介導，減少氧化脂蛋白對內皮的損傷效應。這是支持 resveratrol 心血管聲譽的基礎血管益處，與 resveratrol 抑制 Lox-1 介導的泡沫細胞形成和促進血管舒張的作用一致。維護內皮完整性對於預防動脈粥樣硬化的啟動和進展至關重要。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol
object: Vasodilation via nitric oxide synthesis modulation

context.en-US: Resveratrol promotes vasodilation by modulating nitric-oxide synthesis, principally via SIRT1-mediated activation of eNOS. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of NO-dependent relaxation. Improved vasodilation lowers vascular resistance and blood pressure, and enhanced NO bioavailability also reduces platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation. This is a direct mechanism behind its cardiovascular effects, and it connects resveratrol's SIRT1-activating action to endothelial function. Because endothelial NO is central to vascular health, resveratrol's ability to boost the SIRT1-eNOS axis underlies much of its reported cardiovascular benefit.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 透過調制一氧化氮合成促進血管舒張，主要透過 SIRT1 介導的 eNOS 活化。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於 NO 依賴性舒張的上游。改善的血管舒張降低血管阻力和血壓，增強的 NO 生物利用度也減少血小板聚集和平滑肌增生。這是其心血管效應的直接機制，並將 resveratrol 的 SIRT1 活化作用與內皮功能聯繫起來。由於內皮 NO 對血管健康至關重要，resveratrol 增強 SIRT1-eNOS 軸線的能力構成了其大部分報導的心血管益處的基礎。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol inhibits platelet aggregation, reducing thrombotic risk and complementing its vascular benefits. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed platelet activation. This also creates a bleeding-risk caveat when combined with anticoagulants such as heparin or warfarin, since the anti-platelet effect adds to the anticoagulant's action. It is one of several anti-atherothrombotic actions of the compound, alongside its vasodilatory and anti-inflammatory effects. Clinicians therefore advise caution in anticoagulated patients, and the platelet effect is considered when assessing resveratrol's overall cardiovascular profile.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 抑制血小板聚集，降低血栓形成風險並補充其血管益處。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於抑制血小板活化的上游。這在與肝素或華法林等抗凝血劑合用時也產生出血風險的警告，因為抗血小板效應會增添抗凝血劑的作用。這是該化合物的多種抗動脈粥樣硬化血栓作用之一，與其血管舒張和抗發炎效應並存。因此，臨床醫師建議在抗凝患者中謹慎使用，在評估 resveratrol 整體心血管特徵時會考慮血小板效應。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol inhibits vascular smooth-muscle cell proliferation, limiting neointimal hyperplasia and atherosclerotic plaque growth. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed VSMC expansion. This restrains the remodeling that narrows vessels after injury, and it complements resveratrol's anti-platelet and vasodilatory effects. The anti-proliferative action likely involves SIRT1, AMPK, and cell-cycle regulation in smooth-muscle cells, and it is relevant to restenosis and the progression of atherosclerosis. By controlling VSMC growth and migration, resveratrol contributes to preserving vascular lumen patency.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 抑制血管平滑肌細胞增殖，限制新生內膜增生和動脈粥樣硬化斑塊生長。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於抑制 VSMC 擴增的上游。這限制了損傷後血管縮窄的重塑過程，並與 resveratrol 的抗血小板和血管舒張效應互補。抗增殖作用可能涉及 SIRT1、AMPK 和平滑肌細胞中的細胞週期調控，與再狹窄和動脈粥樣硬化進展相關。透過控制 VSMC 的生長和遷移，resveratrol 有助於維護血管腔的通暢性。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol enhances coronary relaxation, reduces ventricular arrhythmias, and inhibits platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation, collectively protecting the heart. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of improved coronary function. These integrated effects support myocardial perfusion under stress and reduce the risk of ischemic events and arrhythmogenesis. They reinforce resveratrol's cardioprotective profile, which is largely attributed to SIRT1, eNOS, and AMPK activation. The combination of improved vasodilation, reduced thrombotic tendency, and restrained vascular remodeling makes resveratrol a multifaceted cardiovascular agent in preclinical models.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 增強冠狀血管舒張、減少心室心律不整並抑制血小板聚集和平滑肌增生，從而整體保護心臟。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於改善冠狀血管功能的上游。這些整合效應在壓力下支持心肌灌注，並降低缺血事件和心律失常發生的風險。它們強化了 resveratrol 的心臟保護特徵，這主要歸因於 SIRT1、eNOS 和 AMPK 的活化。改善血管舒張、降低血栓傾向和抑制血管重塑的組合使 resveratrol 成為臨床前模型中的多面向心血管活性物質。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol reduces ventricular arrhythmias in preclinical models, likely via antioxidant, ion-channel, and eNOS-modulating actions. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of reduced arrhythmogenesis. This adds an electrophysiological benefit to its cardiovascular profile, and it is observed in animal studies with uncertain human translation. The anti-arrhythmic effect may reflect stabilization of cardiac ion channels, reduced oxidative stress, and improved NO signaling in the myocardium. These findings support resveratrol's reputation as a cardioprotective compound, though the relevance to human arrhythmia remains to be established in clinical settings.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 在臨床前模型中減少心室心律不整，可能透過抗氧化、離子通道和 eNOS 調節作用。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於減少心律失常的上游。這為其心血管特徵增添了電生理學益處，但在動物研究中觀察到的結果其人類轉化尚不確定。抗心律不整效應可能反映了心臟離子通道的穩定化、氧化壓力的降低以及心肌中 NO 訊號的改善。這些發現支持 resveratrol 作為心臟保護化合物的聲譽，但其與人類心律不整的相關性仍需在臨床環境中確立。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol improves glucose metabolism and reduces LDL while elevating HDL, improving the lipid profile in metabolic models. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of better glycemic and lipoprotein control. These effects are largely SIRT1/AMPK-dependent, reflecting improved insulin sensitivity, reduced hepatic lipogenesis, and enhanced lipid oxidation. Human outcomes, however, are limited by resveratrol's poor bioavailability and short half-life, so translating these metabolic benefits to patients requires formulations that achieve effective plasma concentrations.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 改善葡萄糖代謝並降低 LDL 同時升高 HDL，改善代謝模型中的血脂特徵。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於改善血糖和脂蛋白控制的上游。這些效應主要依賴 SIRT1/AMPK，反映胰島素敏感性改善、肝臟脂肪生成減少和脂質氧化增強。然而，由於 resveratrol 生物利用度低且半衰期短，人體結果有限，因此要將這些代謝益處轉化為患者需要能達到有效血漿濃度的製劑。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol is a relatively poor direct antioxidant, weaker than vitamin C or cysteine at scavenging free radicals in vitro. Directionally, its redox-scavenging capacity is minor. Its biological benefits therefore arise mainly from signaling modulation—activation of SIRT1, AMPK, and eNOS, and inhibition of PDE4—rather than from stoichiometric antioxidant action. This corrects the simplistic antioxidant framing of resveratrol and explains why its effects can persist well after the compound has been metabolized. Understanding resveratrol as a hormetic signaling molecule rather than a direct antioxidant is central to interpreting its pharmacology.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 是相對較弱的直接抗氧化劑，在體外清除自由基的能力弱於維生素 C 或半胱氨酸。在方向性上，其氧化還原清除能力較次要。因此其生物學益處主要來自訊號調制——活化 SIRT1、AMPK 和 eNOS，以及抑制 PDE4——而非化學計量的抗氧化作用。這修正了對 resveratrol 簡單化的抗氧化框架，並解釋了為何其效應在化合物被代謝後仍能持續存在。將 resveratrol 理解為激效性訊號分子而非直接抗氧化劑，是詮釋其藥理學的關鍵。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol demonstrates antiviral effects in some experimental systems, though the evidence base is moderate and mechanism-dependent. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of viral inhibition in those models. Potential mechanisms include modulation of host stress and inflammatory pathways, inhibition of viral replication enzymes, and effects on cellular signaling that restrict viral spread. Clinical relevance remains preliminary, and the poor bioavailability of resveratrol limits translation. Nonetheless, the antiviral observations contribute to the compound's broad bioactivity profile and warrant further investigation of its role in host defense against specific viruses.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 在某些實驗系統中展現抗病毒效應，但證據基礎為中等且取決於機制。在方向性上，resveratrol 在這些模型中位於抑制病毒的上游。潛在機制包括調節宿主壓力和發炎途徑、抑制病毒複製酶以及影響限制病毒傳播的細胞訊號。臨床相關性仍處於初步階段，且 resveratrol 的低生物利用度限制了轉化。儘管如此，抗病毒觀察結果促進了該化合物廣泛的生物活性特徵，值得進一步研究其在宿主對抗特定病毒防禦中的作用。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol shows anti-neoplastic effects in preclinical models, including cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis induction, though confidence in human translation is moderate. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed tumor phenotype in those systems. Mechanisms may involve modulation of SIRT1, AMPK, NF-κB, and p53, which together restrain proliferation and promote death of cancer cells. Robust human anticancer efficacy is unproven, and bioavailability remains a major limitation. Nonetheless, the breadth of resveratrol's anti-cancer mechanisms continues to drive interest in its use as an adjunctive agent in oncology research.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 在臨床前模型中展現抗腫瘤效應，包括細胞週期阻滯和凋亡誘導，但對人體轉化的信心為中等。在方向性上，resveratrol 在這些系統中位於抑制腫瘤表型的上游。機制可能涉及 SIRT1、AMPK、NF-κB 和 p53 的調節，共同抑制癌細胞的增殖並促進其死亡。resveratrol 在人體中的抗癌療效尚未被證實，生物利用度仍是主要限制。儘管如此，resveratrol 抗癌機制的廣度持續推動著將其作為腫瘤學研究中輔助用藥的興趣。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 is highly expressed in the vasculature, including endothelial and smooth-muscle cells, positioning it as a central regulator of vascular homeostasis. Directionally, constitutive vascular abundance enables rapid SIRT1 responses to metabolic and shear stress. This expression pattern underlies its roles in vasodilation, inflammation, and atherosclerosis, and loss of vascular SIRT1 promotes endothelial dysfunction. Because the endothelium is constantly exposed to hemodynamic and metabolic signals, SIRT1's abundance in this tissue allows it to integrate nutrient status with vascular function, making it a key determinant of blood-vessel health and disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在血管系統中高度表達，包括內皮細胞和平滑肌細胞，使其成為血管恆定性的核心調節因子。在方向性上，組成性的血管豐度使 SIRT1 能夠快速回應代謝和剪切壓力。這種表達模式奠定了其在血管舒張、發炎和動脈粥樣硬化中的角色，而血管 SIRT1 的缺失促進內皮功能障礙。由於內皮持續暴露於血液動力學和代謝訊號，SIRT1 在此組織中的豐度使其能將營養狀態與血管功能整合，成為血管健康和疾病的關鍵決定因素。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 modulates angiogenic activity during vascular remodeling and growth, influencing endothelial sprouting and vessel stability in a context-dependent manner. Directionally, SIRT1 tunes angiogenic signaling. It can either promote or restrain angiogenesis depending on oxygen and metabolic cues, reflecting SIRT1's integration of stress and metabolic inputs in the vessel wall. In some settings SIRT1 supports the neovascularization needed for tissue repair, while in others it limits the pathological angiogenesis that feeds tumors. This context-dependence makes SIRT1 a nuanced regulator of vessel growth, with implications for both regenerative medicine and oncology.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在血管重塑和生長過程中調節血管生成活性，以情境依賴的方式影響內皮萌芽和血管穩定性。在方向性上，SIRT1 調節血管生成訊號。根據氧氣和代謝訊號的不同，SIRT1 可以促進或限制血管生成，反映了 SIRT1 在血管壁中整合壓力和代謝輸入的能力。在某些情況下，SIRT1 支持組織修復所需的新血管生成，而在其他情況下則限制餵養腫瘤的病理性血管生成。這種情境依賴性使 SIRT1 成為血管生長的精細調節因子，對再生醫學和腫瘤學都有影響。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates endothelial nitric-oxide synthase (eNOS), activating it and enhancing endothelial NO production, which promotes vasodilation and vascular protection. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically activates eNOS. This is a canonical SIRT1 vascular mechanism, also engaged by resveratrol, and it links sirtuin activity directly to endothelial function. Enhanced NO production reduces vascular tone, inhibits platelet aggregation, and suppresses leukocyte adhesion, contributing to the atheroprotective effects of SIRT1. The SIRT1-eNOS axis is one of the best-characterized connections between sirtuin biology and cardiovascular health.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化內皮型一氧化氮合酶（eNOS），使其活化並增強內皮 NO 產生，從而促進血管舒張和血管保護。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式活化 eNOS。這是經典的 SIRT1 血管機制，也被 resveratrol 利用，它將 sirtuin 活性直接與內皮功能聯繫起來。增強的 NO 產生降低血管張力、抑制血小板聚集並抑制白血球黏附，有助於 SIRT1 的抗動脈粥樣硬化效應。SIRT1-eNOS 軸線是 sirtuin 生物學與心血管健康之間最佳表徵的聯繫之一。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 downregulates angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R) expression in vascular smooth-muscle cells, reducing angiotensin-II signaling. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of AT1R suppression. Lower AT1R diminishes vasoconstriction and hypertensive signaling, contributing to SIRT1's antihypertensive actions. This is consistent with the observation that resveratrol-driven SIRT1 elevation reduces angiotensin-II-induced hypertension in vivo. By dampening the renin-angiotensin system's most important receptor, SIRT1 provides vascular protection that parallels the effects of AT1R blockers, positioning sirtuin activation as a complementary approach to blood-pressure control.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在血管平滑肌細胞中下調血管張力素 II 1 型受體（AT1R）的表達，減少血管張力素 II 的訊號傳導。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於 AT1R 抑制的上游。較低的 AT1R 減少血管收縮和高血壓訊號，有助於 SIRT1 的降血壓作用。這與 resveratrol 驅動的 SIRT1 上調在體內減少血管張力素 II 誘導的高血壓的觀察一致。透過抑制腎素-血管張力素系統最重要的受體，SIRT1 提供了類似 AT1R 阻斷劑效果的血管保護，將 sirtuin 活化定位為血壓控制的互補方法。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 regulates tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase 3 (TIMP3), an endogenous inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinases that defends against vascular inflammation and remodeling. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of TIMP3 regulation. By preserving TIMP3, SIRT1 limits extracellular-matrix degradation and inflammatory infiltration in vessels, protecting the vessel wall from pathological remodeling. This adds a matrix-protective dimension to SIRT1's vascular role, complementing its effects on eNOS, AT1R, and NF-κB. TIMP3 also regulates TNF-α signaling, so SIRT1-dependent TIMP3 maintenance connects sirtuins to both matrix homeostasis and inflammatory control.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 調控金屬蛋白酶組織抑制因子 3（TIMP3），一種基質金屬蛋白酶的內源性抑制因子，保護血管免受發炎和重塑。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於 TIMP3 調控的上游。透過維護 TIMP3，SIRT1 限制血管中的細胞外基質降解和發炎浸潤，保護血管壁免受病理性重塑。這為 SIRT1 的血管角色增添了基質保護維度，與其對 eNOS、AT1R 和 NF-κB 的效應互補。TIMP3 也調控 TNF-α 訊號，因此 SIRT1 依賴性的 TIMP3 維持將 sirtuin 與基質恆定性和發炎控制聯繫起來。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: Nuclear SIRT1 (enhanced by resveratrol)

context.en-US: Nuclear SIRT1, enhanced by resveratrol, induces superoxide dismutase in cardiomyocytes, an antioxidant enzyme that suppresses cell death under stress. Directionally, nuclear SIRT1 sits upstream of SOD induction. This is a cardiomyoprotective output of resveratrol's SIRT1 activation, reducing oxidative damage and preserving cardiac cell viability during injury. It complements SIRT1's other cardiac actions, including SERCA2a deacetylation and PPARα activation, and it illustrates how resveratrol engages nuclear sirtuin activity to boost endogenous antioxidant defense. The SOD induction is part of the broader FOXO3a-dependent antioxidant program driven by SIRT1.
context.zh-TW: 核 SIRT1 在 resveratrol 增強下誘導心肌細胞中的超氧化物歧化酶，一種在壓力下抑制細胞死亡的抗氧化酶。在方向性上，核 SIRT1 位於 SOD 誘導的上游。這是 resveratrol SIRT1 活化的心肌保護輸出，在損傷期間減少氧化損傷並維護心臟細胞活性。這與 SIRT1 的其他心臟作用互補，包括 SERCA2a 去乙醯化和 PPARα 活化，並說明 resveratrol 如何利用核 sirtuin 活性來增強內源性抗氧化防禦。SOD 誘導是 SIRT1 驅動的更廣泛 FOXO3a 依賴性抗氧化程式的一部分。

source_document: _document_ - The Sirtuin System The Holy Grail of Resveratrol?.md

subject: SIRT3-deficient mice
object: Severe cardiac hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis

context.en-US: SIRT3-deficient mice develop severe cardiac hypertrophy and interstitial fibrosis when challenged with a hypertrophic stimulus, revealing SIRT3's protective role in the heart. Directionally, SIRT3 loss leads to pathological cardiac remodeling. This is driven by elevated ROS and impaired mitochondrial function, which fuel the hypertrophic and fibrotic response. It mirrors the resistance seen when SIRT3 is overexpressed, confirming a causal protective role. The phenotype highlights the importance of mitochondrial sirtuin activity for cardiac health and supports SIRT3 activation as a therapeutic strategy to prevent maladaptive remodeling in heart disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 缺陷小鼠在受到肥大性刺激時會發展出嚴重的心臟肥大和間質纖維化，揭示了 SIRT3 在心臟中的保護角色。在方向性上，SIRT3 的缺失導致病理性心臟重塑。這由 ROS 升高和粒線體功能障礙所驅動，它們為肥大性和纖維化反應提供動力。這反映了 SIRT3 過度表達時所見的抗性，確認了因果保護角色。此表型突顯了粒線體 sirtuin 活性對心臟健康的重要性，並支持 SIRT3 活化作為預防心臟病中不良重塑的治療策略。

source_document: SIRT3.md

subject: SIRT3-overexpressing mice

context.en-US: Transgenic mice overexpressing SIRT3 are significantly resistant to stimuli-induced cardiac hypertrophy, the inverse of the SIRT3-null phenotype. Directionally, SIRT3 gain leads to hypertrophy resistance. This protection arises from better mitochondrial ROS control, antioxidant enzyme expression, and metabolic flexibility, which together blunt the growth signals that drive pathological remodeling. It validates SIRT3 as a cardiac therapeutic target and is consistent with SIRT3's regulation of MnSOD, catalase, and mitochondrial Complex I. The complementary loss- and gain-of-function phenotypes firmly establish SIRT3 as a central cardiac protector.
context.zh-TW: 過度表達 SIRT3 的轉基因小鼠對刺激誘導的心臟肥大具有顯著抗性，與 SIRT3 缺失表型相反。在方向性上，SIRT3 功能增強導致肥大抗性。這種保護源於更好的粒線體 ROS 控制、抗氧化酶表達和代謝靈活性，共同削弱驅動病理性重塑的生長訊號。它驗證了 SIRT3 作為心臟治療靶標，並與 SIRT3 對 MnSOD、過氧化氫酶和粒線體 Complex I 的調控一致。互補的功能缺失和功能增強表型確立了 SIRT3 作為核心心臟保護因子的地位。

source_document: SIRT3.md

subject: SIRT7-deficient mice

context.en-US: SIRT7-deficient mice show extensive myocardial fibrosis, high basal apoptosis, and cardiomyopathy, reflecting SIRT7's role in maintaining cardiac homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT7 loss leads to fibrotic cardiomyopathy. This contrasts with contexts where SIRT7 promotes fibrosis under stress, indicating that SIRT7 is overall required for myocardial integrity. The phenotype likely reflects SIRT7's contributions to ribosome biogenesis, mitochondrial function, and transcriptional regulation in cardiomyocytes, and it is consistent with SIRT7's deacetylation of GATA4 in stress-induced hypertrophy. SIRT7 thus has both protective and pathological cardiac roles depending on context.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7 缺陷小鼠顯示廣泛的心肌纖維化、高基礎凋亡率和心肌病變，反映了 SIRT7 在維護心臟恆定性中的角色。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致纖維化性心肌病變。這與 SIRT7 在壓力下促進纖維化的情況形成對比，表明 SIRT7 整體上是心肌完整性所必需的。此表型可能反映了 SIRT7 對核糖體生物合成、粒線體功能和心肌細胞轉錄調控的貢獻，並與 SIRT7 在壓力誘導肥大中對 GATA4 的去乙醯化一致。因此，SIRT7 根據情境具有保護性和病理性心臟角色。

source_document: GATA4.md

subject: Red wine matrix

context.en-US: Resveratrol achieves efficacious levels only when ingested within the red-wine matrix, which contains co-constituents that slow its metabolism and improve exposure. Directionally, matrix components sit upstream of better resveratrol bioavailability. This helps resolve discrepancies between in vitro potency and in vivo human trials, and it supports whole-food approaches over isolated-compound supplementation. Quercetin and ethanol in particular may inhibit resveratrol's catabolic enzymes, prolonging its presence. The matrix effect is a key consideration for designing resveratrol formulations and for interpreting epidemiological associations between wine consumption and health.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 只有在紅酒基質中攝入時才能達到有效水平，該基質含有共同成分可減緩其代謝並改善暴露量。在方向性上，基質成分位於改善 resveratrol 生物利用度的上游。這有助於解決體外效力和體內人體試驗之間的差異，並支持全食物方法而非單獨化合物補充。特別是槲皮素和乙醇可能抑制 resveratrol 的分解代謝酶，延長其存在時間。基質效應是設計 resveratrol 製劑和詮釋葡萄酒消費與健康之間流行病學關聯的關鍵考量。

source_document: _document_ - The Sirtuin System The Holy Grail of Resveratrol?.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol has a very short plasma half-life of roughly 8-14 minutes because of rapid conjugation and clearance. Directionally, rapid metabolism sits upstream of low systemic exposure. This severely limits the duration of any SIRT1 activation after a single dose, and it is the central pharmacological obstacle to translating resveratrol's preclinical benefits to humans. Sustained-release formulations, metabolic inhibitors such as quercetin, and delivery within the red-wine matrix are strategies to improve exposure. Understanding the half-life is essential for interpreting both negative clinical trials and claims about resveratrol's efficacy.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 的血漿半衰期非常短，約 8-14 分鐘，因為快速的結合和清除。在方向性上，快速代謝位於低系統暴露量的上游。這嚴重限制了單次劑量後 SIRT1 活化的持續時間，是將 resveratrol 臨床前益處轉化到人體的核心藥理學障礙。緩釋製劑、槲皮素等代謝抑制劑以及在紅酒基質中的遞送是改善暴露量的策略。理解半衰期對於詮釋陰性臨床試驗和關於 resveratrol 療效的主張至關重要。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes contribute to resveratrol catabolism, alongside phase-II conjugation, determining its metabolic fate. Directionally, CYP enzymes sit upstream of resveratrol clearance. This hepatic handling caps bioavailability, and it is relevant to drug-drug interactions and dosing, since resveratrol both is metabolized by and inhibits cytochrome P450 activity. The combination of rapid conjugation and CYP-mediated oxidation explains resveratrol's short half-life. Because resveratrol can both be metabolized by and inhibit CYP enzymes, co-administered drugs may see altered clearance, a clinically important consideration for supplementation.
context.zh-TW: 肝臟細胞色素 P450 酶參與 resveratrol 的分解代謝，與第二相結合作用共同決定其代謝命運。在方向性上，CYP 酶位於 resveratrol 清除的上游。這種肝臟處理限制了生物利用度，與藥物-藥物相互作用和劑量相關，因為 resveratrol 既被細胞色素 P450 代謝也抑制其活性。快速結合作用與 CYP 介導的氧化的結合解釋了 resveratrol 的短半衰期。由於 resveratrol 可以既被 CYP 酶代謝又抑制其活性，合併用藥可能看到清除率改變，這是補充劑使用中臨床重要的考量。

source_document: Cytochrome P450.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol both is metabolized by and inhibits cytochrome P450 activity, creating a self-reinforcing effect on its own clearance and on co-administered drugs. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of CYP inhibition. This can alter the pharmacokinetics of other medications, since CYP inhibition slows their metabolism, and it also affects resveratrol's own disposition. It is a clinically relevant interaction caveat for supplementation, especially in patients taking drugs with narrow therapeutic windows. Understanding the bidirectional CYP relationship is important for predicting both resveratrol's bioavailability and its potential to influence drug exposure.
context.zh-TW: Resveratrol 既被細胞色素 P450 代謝也抑制其活性，對自身清除和合併用藥產生自我強化效應。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於 CYP 抑制的上游。這可以改變其他藥物的藥動學，因為 CYP 抑制會減慢其代謝，同時也影響 resveratrol 自身的處置。這是補充劑使用的臨床相關相互作用警告，特別是在服用治療窗窄的藥物的患者中。理解雙向 CYP 關係對於預測 resveratrol 的生物利用度及其影響藥物暴露的潛力至關重要。

source_document: Cytochrome P450.md

subject: Quercetin and ethanol

context.en-US: Quercetin and ethanol, red-wine constituents, augment resveratrol activity possibly by inhibiting its catabolic enzymes and improving exposure. Directionally, these co-compounds sit upstream of enhanced resveratrol effect. This helps explain the matrix/bioavailability phenomenon, whereby resveratrol shows efficacy within the whole-food matrix but not as an isolated compound. It suggests combination formulations could improve efficacy, and it is consistent with the idea that polyphenols act synergistically. The augmentation is particularly relevant to interpreting the French paradox and to designing resveratrol-based interventions that replicate the wine matrix.
context.zh-TW: 槲皮素和乙醇作為紅酒成分，增強 resveratrol 的活性，可能透過抑制其分解代謝酶並改善暴露量。在方向性上，這些共同化合物位於增強 resveratrol 效應的上游。這有助於解釋基質/生物利用度現象，即 resveratrol 在全食物基質中顯示療效但作為單獨化合物則不然。這暗示組合製劑可以提高療效，與多酚類物質协同作用的概念一致。這種增效作用對於詮釋法國悖論和設計複製葡萄酒基質的 resveratrol 干預措施特別相關。

source_document: _document_ - The Sirtuin System The Holy Grail of Resveratrol?.md

subject: French Paradox
object: Reduced CVD incidence with moderate wine consumption despite high-fat diet

context.en-US: The French paradox describes lower cardiovascular-disease incidence in some French populations despite high-fat diets, often attributed in part to moderate wine and resveratrol consumption. Directionally, moderate wine intake sits upstream of reduced CVD in this epidemiological observation. Causality is debated, with diet and lifestyle confounders complicating the interpretation, and the wine matrix and polyphenol content may contribute. Resveratrol's vascular actions provide a plausible, but not proven, mechanism, and the concept has driven considerable research into wine polyphenols, sirtuins, and cardiovascular health.
context.zh-TW: 法國悖論描述了某些法國人群中儘管高脂飲食但心血管疾病發生率較低的現象，部分歸因於適度的葡萄酒和 resveratrol 消費。在方向性上，適度的葡萄酒攝入在此流行病學觀察中位於降低心血管疾病的上游。因果關係存在爭議，飲食和生活方式混雜因素使解釋複雜化，葡萄酒基質和多酚含量可能有所貢獻。resveratrol 的血管作用提供了一個合理的但尚未被證實的機制，此概念已推動了大量關於葡萄酒多酚、sirtuin 和心血管健康的研究。

source_document: French Paradox.md

subject: Resveratrol
object: Bleeding risk with concurrent anticoagulant use

context.en-US: Because resveratrol inhibits platelet aggregation, concurrent use with anticoagulants such as heparin or warfarin may increase bleeding risk. Directionally, resveratrol combined with anticoagulants sits upstream of heightened bleeding liability. This is a practical safety caveat for supplementation, and clinicians advise caution in anticoagulated patients. The additive anti-platelet and anticoagulant effects raise the risk of hemorrhage, particularly at higher doses. Anyone taking blood thinners should discuss resveratrol supplementation with their healthcare provider, since the interaction is plausible based on resveratrol's pharmacology.
context.zh-TW: 由於 resveratrol 抑制血小板聚集，與肝素或華法林等抗凝血劑同時使用可能增加出血風險。在方向性上，resveratrol 與抗凝血劑的結合位於出血風險增加的上游。這是補充劑使用的實際安全警告，臨床醫師建議在抗凝患者中謹慎使用。附加的抗血小板和抗凝血效應增加出血風險，特別是在較高劑量時。任何服用血液稀釋劑的人都應與其醫療保健提供者討論 resveratrol 補充劑，因為基於 resveratrol 的藥理學，此相互作用是合理的。

source_document: _document_ - berrougui2009_resveratrol_as_atheroprotective_compound.md

subject: SIRT1 downregulation of angiotensin II type 1 receptor

context.en-US: SIRT1-mediated downregulation of AT1R expression produces antihypertensive effects; in vivo, resveratrol-driven SIRT1 elevation reduces angiotensin-II-induced hypertension. Directionally, SIRT1-mediated AT1R suppression sits upstream of lower blood pressure. This couples SIRT1 activation to vascular tone control, since reduced AT1R diminishes angiotensin-II-driven vasoconstriction and sodium retention. It is a mechanistic basis for resveratrol's antihypertensive actions, and it parallels the therapeutic strategy of AT1R blockade used clinically. By targeting the same receptor the drugs block, SIRT1 provides an endogenous route to restrain the renin-angiotensin system.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 介導的 AT1R 表達下調產生降血壓效應；在體內，resveratrol 驅動的 SIRT1 上調減少血管張力素 II 誘導的高血壓。在方向性上，SIRT1 介導的 AT1R 抑制位於降低血壓的上游。這將 SIRT1 活化與血管張力控制偶聯，因為減少的 AT1R 減弱血管張力素 II 驅動的血管收縮和鈉滯留。這是 resveratrol 降血壓作用的機制性基礎，與臨床使用的 AT1R 阻斷治療策略相似。透過靶向與藥物阻斷的相同受體，SIRT1 提供了抑制腎素-血管張力素系統的內源性途徑。

source_document: Angiotensin II.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates Beclin-1 at multiple lysines, promoting its interaction with the class III PI3K Vps34 and enhancing autophagy initiation and flux. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically licenses Beclin-1. This supports autophagosome formation and cellular clearance, and it is a central SIRT1 autophagy substrate alongside LC3, Atg5, Atg7, and ULK1. By deacetylating Beclin-1, SIRT1 promotes the assembly of the autophagy initiation complex and couples nutrient status to cellular quality control. This mechanism contributes to SIRT1's protection against the accumulation of damaged proteins and organelles during aging.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在多個賴氨酸位點去乙醯化 Beclin-1，促進其與 III 型 PI3K Vps34 的相互作用並增強自噬啟動和通量。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式啟用 Beclin-1。這支持自噬體形成和細胞清除，是 SIRT1 的核心自噬底物之一，與 LC3、Atg5、Atg7 和 ULK1 並列。透過去乙醯化 Beclin-1，SIRT1 促進自噬啟動複合物的組裝，並將營養狀態與細胞品質控制偶聯。此機制有助於 SIRT1 在衰老過程中防止受損蛋白質和細胞器的積累。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: In pancreatic β-cells, SIRT6 deacetylates FoxO1 and increases GLUT2 expression to maintain glucose-sensing ability and systemic glucose tolerance. Directionally, SIRT6 enzymatically activates FoxO1 in β-cells. This preserves insulin-secretory competence under metabolic challenge, since GLUT2 is required for β-cells to sense glucose and respond appropriately. It mirrors SIRT6's broader metabolic-protective phenotype, including its repression of TXNIP to maintain glucose-stimulated insulin secretion. SIRT6's β-cell function is essential for preventing the glucose-intolerant state that characterizes type 2 diabetes.
context.zh-TW: 在胰腺 β 細胞中，SIRT6 去乙醯化 FoxO1 並增加 GLUT2 表達以維護葡萄糖感知能力和全身葡萄糖耐受性。在方向性上，SIRT6 以酶性方式在 β 細胞中活化 FoxO1。這在代謝挑戰下維護胰島素分泌能力，因為 GLUT2 是 β 細胞感知葡萄糖並適當回應所必需的。這反映了 SIRT6 更廣泛的代謝保護表型，包括其抑制 TXNIP 以維護葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌。SIRT6 的 β 細胞功能對預防第二型糖尿病的葡萄糖耐受不良狀態至關重要。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: SIRT6 promotes AMPK expression, which upregulates antioxidant genes MnSOD and catalase to suppress oxidative stress. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of AMPK induction. This couples SIRT6's chromatin functions to metabolic stress sensing, broadening SIRT6's protective network beyond deacetylation. Because AMPK also raises NAD+ and activates PGC-1α, SIRT6-dependent AMPK induction engages the full energy-sensing cascade. The antioxidant output of this axis protects cells from the oxidative damage that accumulates with age, and it complements SIRT6's direct roles in DNA repair and genome stability.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 促進 AMPK 表達，AMPK 上調抗氧化基因 MnSOD 和過氧化氫酶以抑制氧化壓力。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 AMPK 誘導的上游。這將 SIRT6 的染色質功能與代謝壓力感知偶聯，擴展了 SIRT6 超越去乙醯化的保護網絡。由於 AMPK 也提高 NAD+ 並活化 PGC-1α，SIRT6 依賴性的 AMPK 誘導啟動了完整的能量感知級聯。此軸線的抗氧化輸出保護細胞免受隨年齡積累的氧化損傷，並與 SIRT6 在 DNA 修復和基因組穩定性中的直接角色互補。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 activates Nrf2 by modifying Keap1 structure, leading to Nrf2 nuclear translocation and expression of antioxidant genes. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of Nrf2 activation. This is a canonical cytoprotective axis against oxidative and electrophilic insult, and it complements SIRT1's direct antioxidant substrate actions through FOXO and PGC-1α. Because Nrf2 coordinates the expression of hundreds of detoxifying and antioxidant enzymes, SIRT1-dependent Nrf2 activation provides broad protection against cellular stress. This pathway is relevant to aging, where declining Nrf2 activity contributes to the accumulation of oxidative damage.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過修飾 Keap1 結構活化 Nrf2，導致 Nrf2 核轉位和抗氧化基因的表達。在方向性上，SIRT1 位於 Nrf2 活化的上游。這是對抗氧化和親電子損傷的經典細胞保護軸線，與 SIRT1 透過 FOXO 和 PGC-1α 的直接抗氧化底物作用互補。由於 Nrf2 協調數百種解毒和抗氧化酶的表達，SIRT1 依賴性的 Nrf2 活化提供了對細胞壓力的廣泛保護。此通路與衰老相關，在衰老中 Nrf2 活性下降導致氧化損傷的積累。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 activates FoxO3a gene expression, increasing transcription of MnSOD and catalase to eliminate mitochondrial ROS. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of FoxO3a-driven antioxidant programs. This links mitochondrial sirtuin activity to nuclear antioxidant transcription, providing a coordinated mitochondrial and cytosolic defense against oxidative stress. It is a key SIRT3 mechanism for redox defense, and it complements SIRT3's direct activation of MnSOD through deacetylation. The SIRT3-FoxO3a axis is particularly important in the heart and during caloric restriction, where it preserves mitochondrial function and limits oxidative injury.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 活化 FoxO3a 基因表達，增加 MnSOD 和過氧化氫酶的轉錄以消除粒線體 ROS。在方向性上，SIRT3 位於 FoxO3a 驅動的抗氧化程式的上游。這將粒線體 sirtuin 活性與核抗氧化轉錄聯繫起來，提供對氧化壓力的協調粒線體和細胞質防禦。這是 SIRT3 紅氧防禦的關鍵機制，與 SIRT3 透過去乙醯化直接活化 MnSOD 互補。SIRT3-FoxO3a 軸線在心臟和限制熱量期間特別重要，在此期間它維護粒線體功能並限制氧化損傷。

source_document: SIRT3.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 protects against inflammation by deacetylating and attenuating NLRP3 activity via the AMPKα/XBP1 pathway in macrophages. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically suppresses NLRP3 through XBP1s. This couples endoplasmic-reticulum stress responses to innate immune regulation, and it is a refined mechanistic view of SIRT1's anti-inflammasome action. By deacetylating XBP1s downstream of AMPK, SIRT1 prevents NLRP3 assembly and the subsequent maturation of IL-1β. This pathway is relevant to atherosclerotic and metabolic disease, where inflammasome-driven inflammation contributes to tissue damage and insulin resistance.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過在巨噬細胞中透過 AMPKα/XBP1 途徑去乙醯化並減弱 NLRP3 活性來保護免受發炎。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式透過 XBP1s 抑制 NLRP3。這將內質網壓力反應與先天免疫調控偶聯，是 SIRT1 抗炎性體效應的精細機制觀點。透過在 AMPK 下游去乙醯化 XBP1s，SIRT1 防止 NLRP3 組裝和隨後的 IL-1β 成熟。此通路與動脈粥樣硬化和代謝疾病相關，在這些疾病中炎性體驅動的發炎導致組織損傷和胰島素阻抗。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates SERCA2a at Lys492, restoring its activity and improving cardiac contractility in heart failure. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically rescues SERCA2a function. Better calcium handling opposes the systolic dysfunction of failing hearts, since SERCA2a-mediated calcium reuptake is depressed in heart failure. This is a direct mechanistic rationale for SIRT1 activation in cardiomyopathy, and it complements SIRT1's effects on PPARα, antioxidant genes, and cardiac metabolism. By restoring the molecular pump that controls cardiac relaxation, SIRT1 addresses a fundamental defect in the failing myocardium.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在 Lys492 位點去乙醯化 SERCA2a，恢復其活性並在心臟衰竭中改善心臟收縮力。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式拯救 SERCA2a 功能。更好的鈣離子處理對抗衰竭心臟的收縮功能障礙，因為 SERCA2a 介導的鈣離子再攝取在心臟衰竭中受到抑制。這是 SIRT1 活化治療心肌病變的直接機制性理由，與 SIRT1 對 PPARα、抗氧化基因和心臟代謝的效應互補。透過恢復控制心臟舒張的分子泵，SIRT1 解決了衰竭心肌的一個根本性缺陷。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: SIRT6 prevents TGF-β1-induced lung myofibroblast differentiation by inactivating TGF-β1/Smad3 signaling, limiting fibrogenesis. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of TGF-β1/Smad3 blockade. This complements SIRT6's other antifibrotic actions in heart and kidney, and it positions SIRT6 as a broad suppressor of Smad3-driven fibrosis. By blocking myofibroblast differentiation, SIRT6 prevents the accumulation of contractile, matrix-producing cells that drive tissue scarring. SIRT6 activation therefore represents a potential strategy for pulmonary fibrosis and other fibrotic diseases where TGF-β signaling is central.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6 透過使 TGF-β1/Smad3 訊號失活來防止 TGF-β1 誘導的肺肌成纖維細胞分化，限制纖維化生成。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 TGF-β1/Smad3 阻斷的上游。這與 SIRT6 在心臟和腎臟中的其他抗纖維化作用互補，將 SIRT6 定位為 Smad3 驅動的纖維化的廣泛抑制因子。透過阻斷肌成纖維細胞分化，SIRT6 防止驅動組織疤痕的收縮性、基質產生細胞的積累。因此 SIRT6 活化代表了肺纖維化和其他以 TGF-β 訊號為核心的纖維化疾病的潛在策略。

source_document: SIRT6.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates mitofusin 2 (MFN2) at Lys655 and Lys662, regulating mitochondrial fusion and quality control; loss of SIRT1 causes defective autophagy linked to impaired MFN2 function. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically modifies MFN2. This connects sirtuin activity to mitochondrial dynamics and mitophagy, and it is relevant to neurodegenerative and metabolic disease where fusion is perturbed. By modulating MFN2, SIRT1 influences the balance between mitochondrial fusion and fission that determines mitochondrial network health. This regulation links SIRT1's pro-autophagy and mitophagy functions to the machinery that maintains mitochondrial integrity.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在 Lys655 和 Lys662 位點去乙醯化 mitofusin 2（MFN2），調控粒線體融合和品質控制；SIRT1 的缺失導致與 MFN2 功能障礙相關的自噬缺陷。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式修飾 MFN2。這將 sirtuin 活性與粒線體動態和粒線體自噬聯繫起來，與融合受擾的神經退行性和代謝疾病相關。透過調節 MFN2，SIRT1 影響決定粒線體網絡健康的粒線體融合與分裂之間的平衡。此調控將 SIRT1 的促自噬和粒線體自噬功能與維護粒線體完整性的機制聯繫起來。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates p53 specifically at Lys379, inhibiting p53-dependent apoptosis and promoting cell survival under genotoxic stress. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatically inactivates p53 at this site. This is one of several lysines, including Lys317 and Lys370, targeted by SIRT1, and the net effect is cytoprotection that can be oncogenic in established tumors. By dampening p53-mediated apoptosis, SIRT1 biases cells toward repair and survival after DNA damage. The p53-SIRT1 axis is thus a double-edged sword, protecting normal tissues but also potentially shielding cancer cells from death signals.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 特別在 Lys379 位點去乙醯化 p53，抑制 p53 依賴性凋亡並在基因毒性壓力下促進細胞存活。在方向性上，SIRT1 以酶性方式在此位點使 p53 失活。這是 SIRT1 靶向的多個賴氨酸位點之一（包括 Lys317 和 Lys370），淨效應是細胞保護，這在已確立的腫瘤中可能具有致瘤性。透過抑制 p53 介導的凋亡，SIRT1 使細胞在 DNA 損傷後傾向於修復和存活。p53-SIRT1 軸線因此是一把雙刃劍，在保護正常組織的同時也可能保護癌細胞免於死亡訊號。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: SIRT5

context.en-US: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling, analogous to its broader adipogenesis-blocking role. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of AMPK activation in adipogenic progenitors. Activated AMPK shifts cells away from lipogenesis and toward catabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the proliferative signals needed for adipocyte maturation. It reaffirms SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat formation, and it is consistent with the general anti-adipogenic theme across sirtuins. By restraining adipocyte differentiation, SIRT5 contributes to the maintenance of metabolic flexibility and the prevention of excessive fat accumulation.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5 透過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 訊號來抑制前脂肪細胞分化，類似於其更廣泛的脂肪生成阻斷角色。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於脂肪生成前體細胞中 AMPK 活化的上游。活化的 AMPK 使細胞從脂肪生成轉向分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的增殖訊號。它再次確認 SIRT5 作為脂肪形成的負調節因子，與 sirtuin 整體的抗脂肪生成主題一致。透過抑制脂肪細胞分化，SIRT5 有助於維護代謝靈活性和預防過度脂肪積累。

source_document: SIRT5.md

subject: Nicotinamide

context.en-US: Nicotinamide, the deamidated form of vitamin B3 and a product of the sirtuin deacetylation reaction, is an endogenous non-competitive feedback inhibitor of sirtuins that binds the C-pocket of the catalytic domain at high concentrations, blocking NAD+ re-entry. High nicotinamide-to-NAD+ ratios therefore suppress SIRT1 activity, providing a natural brake that is relieved when the ratio is high, for example during caloric restriction. This rationalizes NAD+ precursor supplementation to disinhibit sirtuins. SIRT5, notably, is relatively resistant to nicotinamide inhibition.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺（Nicotinamide）是維生素 B3 的去醯胺形式，也是 sirtuin 去乙醯化反應的產物，是 sirtuin 的內源性非競爭性回饋抑制劑，在高濃度時結合催化域的 C 型口袋，阻斷 NAD+ 的再進入。因此高菸鹼醯胺/NAD+ 比率會抑制 SIRT1 活性，提供一種在比率升高時（例如在限制熱量期間）被解除的天然制動器。這合理解釋了使用 NAD+ 前驅物補充以解除 sirtuin 抑制的策略。值得注意的是，SIRT5 對菸鹼醯胺抑制具有相對抗性。

source_document: SIRT1.md

subject: NAMPT

context.en-US: NAMPT condenses nicotinamide with 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate (PRPP) to form NMN, the rate-limiting step of the NAD+ salvage pathway. Directionally, NAMPT sits upstream of NMN and NAD+ biosynthesis. This recovers nicotinamide that would otherwise feedback-inhibit sirtuins, and AMPK and SIRT1 both induce NAMPT, creating a positive loop for NAD+ and sirtuin activity. Because NAMPT is rate-limiting, its regulation largely determines NAD+ availability in most tissues. Preserving or inducing NAMPT is thus a central strategy for maintaining sirtuin function and NAD+-dependent metabolism.
context.zh-TW: NAMPT 將菸鹼醯胺與 5-磷酸核糖基-1-焦磷酸（PRPP）縮合形成 NMN，這是 NAD+ 補救途徑的限速步驟。在方向性上，NAMPT 位於 NMN 和 NAD+ 生物合成的上游。這回收了原本會回饋抑制 sirtuin 的菸鹼醯胺，而 AMPK 和 SIRT1 都能誘導 NAMPT，為 NAD+ 和 sirtuin 活性創造正反饋迴圈。由於 NAMPT 是限速酶，其調控在很大程度上決定了大多數組織中的 NAD+ 可用性。維護或誘導 NAMPT 因此是維護 sirtuin 功能和 NAD+ 依賴性代謝的核心策略。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: CD38

context.en-US: CD38 consumes NAD+ to produce nicotinamide and cyclic ADP-ribose (cADPR), competing with sirtuins for the same NAD+ pool. Directionally, CD38 sits upstream of NAD+ depletion and nicotinamide generation. Because nicotinamide feedback-inhibits sirtuins, CD38 activity doubly suppresses sirtuin function—both by consuming their co-substrate and by generating an inhibitor. Inhibiting CD38 preserves NAD+ and boosts sirtuin activity, which is the basis for CD38-inhibitor strategies in aging. CD38 expression rises with age, accelerating NAD+ decline and compromising sirtuin-dependent maintenance.
context.zh-TW: CD38 消耗 NAD+ 產生菸鹼醯胺和環化 ADP-核糖（cADPR），與 sirtuin 競爭同一 NAD+ 池。在方向性上，CD38 位於 NAD+ 耗竭和菸鹼醯胺產生的上游。由於菸鹼醯胺回饋抑制 sirtuin，CD38 活性雙重抑制 sirtuin 功能——既消耗其共同底物又產生抑制劑。抑制 CD38 可保存 NAD+ 並增強 sirtuin 活性，這是衰老中 CD38 抑制劑策略的基礎。CD38 表達隨年齡增長而升高，加速 NAD+ 下降並損害 sirtuin 依賴性的維護功能。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins (overview, CD38 KO risks, cancer therapies).md

subject: SIRT5

context.en-US: Unlike SIRT1-SIRT3, SIRT5 is relatively resistant to inhibition by physiological concentrations of nicotinamide, making its desuccinylase activity less sensitive to the natural feedback brake. Directionally, nicotinamide fails to strongly inhibit SIRT5. This may preserve SIRT5's metabolic functions even when NAD+ salvage flux generates nicotinamide, and it distinguishes SIRT5's regulatory wiring from other sirtuins. Because SIRT5 coordinates urea-cycle, ketogenic, and fatty-acid-oxidation enzymes during fasting, its resistance to feedback inhibition may ensure that catabolic nitrogen and lipid handling continues even when nicotinamide accumulates.
context.zh-TW: 與 SIRT1-SIRT3 不同，SIRT5 對生理濃度的菸鹼醯胺抑制具有相對抗性，使其去琥珀醯酶活性不太受天然回饋制動器的影響。在方向性上，菸鹼醯胺未能有效抑制 SIRT5。這可能在 NAD+ 補救通量產生菸鹼醯胺時仍保留 SIRT5 的代謝功能，並將 SIRT5 的調控網絡與其他 sirtuin 區分開來。由於 SIRT5 在禁食期間協調尿素循環、生酮和脂肪酸氧化酶，其對回饋抑制的抗性可能確保即使在菸鹼醯胺積累時，分解代謝的氮和脂質處理仍能繼續。

source_document: SIRT5.md

subject: TGF-beta1

context.en-US: TGF-β1 binds the type II receptor (TβRII), which recruits and phosphorylates the type I receptor (TβRI), leading to phosphorylation and nuclear translocation of SMAD2/3 to drive fibrotic transcription. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of SMAD3 activation. This canonical pathway is the main driver of pathological fibrosis across organs, inducing collagen, fibronectin, and other matrix genes. Sirtuins such as SIRT6 and SIRT7 intersect this axis at multiple points, either by deacetylating SMAD3 or by repressing SMAD3-dependent transcription. Understanding the TGF-β/SMAD cascade is essential for interpreting sirtuin effects on fibrosis.
context.zh-TW: TGF-β1 結合 II 型受體（TβRII），後者招募並磷酸化 I 型受體（TβRI），導致 SMAD2/3 磷酸化和核轉位以驅動纖維化轉錄。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於 SMAD3 活化的上游。此經典途徑是跨器官病理性纖維化的主要驅動因子，誘導膠原蛋白、纖維連接蛋白和其他基質基因。如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7 等 sirtuin 在多個節點與此軸線交匯，或透過去乙醯化 SMAD3 或抑制 SMAD3 依賴性轉錄。理解 TGF-β/SMAD 級聯對於詮釋 sirtuin 對纖維化的效應至關重要。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: TGF-beta1

context.en-US: TGF-β1 activates SMAD3-dependent transcription of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1, COL3A1, FN1, ACTA2, and TIMP1, driving collagen deposition and tissue scarring in multiple organs. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of fibrogenesis. This makes TGF-β1 a central target in fibrosis therapeutics, and sirtuins that inhibit SMAD3 signaling, such as SIRT6 and SIRT7, are antifibrotic. Because fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic organ injury, understanding the TGF-β1/SMAD3 axis is central to developing treatments for heart, lung, kidney, and liver fibrosis. Sirtuin activation is emerging as one such strategy.
context.zh-TW: TGF-β1 活化 SMAD3 依賴性的促纖維化基因轉錄，包括 COL1A1、COL3A1、FN1、ACTA2 和 TIMP1，驅動多個器官的膠原沉積和組織疤痕形成。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於纖維化生成的上游。這使 TGF-β1 成為纖維化治療的核心靶標，而抑制 SMAD3 訊號的 sirtuin（如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7）具有抗纖維化作用。由於纖維化是慢性器官損傷的共同最終通路，理解 TGF-β1/SMAD3 軸線對開發心臟、肺、腎臟和肝臟纖維化的治療至關重要。Sirtuin 活化正成為此類策略之一。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SMAD3

context.en-US: Hyperactivated SMAD3 binds the 3'-UTR of the TFEB gene and inhibits its transcription, reducing lysosomal biogenesis and autophagic flux during fibrosis. Directionally, SMAD3 sits upstream of TFEB repression. This links TGF-β1 signaling to impaired autophagy and waste clearance, contributing to the accumulation of damaged components in fibrotic tissue. Sirtuin modulation of SMAD3 can therefore influence TFEB-dependent homeostasis, and sirtuins such as SIRT6 and SIRT7 that restrain SMAD3 may indirectly preserve TFEB expression. This connection between TGF-β signaling and autophagic capacity is relevant to both fibrosis and aging.
context.zh-TW: 過度活化的 SMAD3 結合 TFEB 基因的 3'-UTR 並抑制其轉錄，在纖維化期間減少溶酶體生物合成和自噬通量。在方向性上，SMAD3 位於 TFEB 抑制的上游。這將 TGF-β1 訊號與自噬和廢物清除受損聯繫起來，導致纖維化組織中受損組件的積累。因此 sirtuin 對 SMAD3 的調控可以影響 TFEB 依賴性的恆定性，而如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7 等抑制 SMAD3 的 sirtuin 可能間接維護 TFEB 表達。TGF-β 訊號和自噬能力之間的這種聯繫與纖維化和衰老都相關。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT7

context.en-US: SIRT7 directly deacetylates SMAD3, reducing its transcriptional activity and pro-fibrotic output downstream of TGF-β1. Directionally, SIRT7 enzymatically inhibits SMAD3. This reveals an antifibrotic, deacetylation-based action of SIRT7 that can oppose TGF-β1 signaling, adding nuance to SIRT7's otherwise sometimes profibrotic cardiac role. The same sirtuin can therefore both promote and suppress fibrosis depending on the signaling context and its state of phosphorylation. By directly modifying SMAD3, SIRT7 provides a molecular brake on TGF-β-driven matrix production in specific settings.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7 直接去乙醯化 SMAD3，降低其轉錄活性和 TGF-β1 下游的促纖維化輸出。在方向性上，SIRT7 以酶性方式抑制 SMAD3。這揭示了 SIRT7 的一種基於去乙醯化的抗纖維化作用，可以對抗 TGF-β1 訊號，為 SIRT7 在其他方面有時具促纖維化作用的心臟角色增添了細微差別。因此同一 sirtuin 可以根據訊號情境和磷酸化狀態既促進又抑制纖維化。透過直接修飾 SMAD3，SIRT7 在特定情況下為 TGF-β 驅動的基質產生提供分子制動器。

source_document: SIRT7.md

subject: BRCA1

context.en-US: BRCA1 is recruited to DNA double-strand breaks by the MRN complex, promotes end resection, and facilitates RAD51 loading via PALB2 and BRCA2 to execute homologous recombination repair. Directionally, BRCA1 sits upstream of high-fidelity double-strand-break repair. Loss of BRCA1 cripples homologous recombination, increasing mutation and cancer risk, particularly in breast and ovarian tissue. Sirtuins such as SIRT2 support BRCA1 localization to damage sites, linking sirtuin activity to genome stability. The BRCA1 pathway is also the basis for synthetic lethality with PARP inhibitors in BRCA-deficient cancers.
context.zh-TW: BRCA1 被 MRN 複合物招募到 DNA 雙鏈斷裂處，促進末端切除，並透過 PALB2 和 BRCA2 協助 RAD51 裝載以執行同源重組修復。在方向性上，BRCA1 位於高保真雙鏈斷裂修復的上游。BRCA1 的缺失損害同源重組，增加突變和癌症風險，特別是在乳腺和卵巢組織中。如 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 支持 BRCA1 定位到損傷位點，將 sirtuin 活性與基因組穩定性聯繫起來。BRCA1 途徑也是 BRCA 缺陷癌症中與 PARP 抑制劑合成致死的基礎。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 deacetylates BRCA1 and promotes its localization to DNA-damage foci; SIRT2 knockdown impairs homologous recombination repair. Directionally, SIRT2 enzymatically licenses BRCA1 for repair. This links cytoplasmic and nuclear SIRT2 to genome stability, and it reveals a tumor-suppressive function of SIRT2 through DNA-repair fidelity. By promoting BRCA1-BARD1 heterodimerization through deacetylation, SIRT2 supports the assembly of the homologous-recombination machinery. Loss of SIRT2 therefore compromises double-strand-break repair and can contribute to genomic instability and cancer predisposition.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 BRCA1 並促進其定位到 DNA 損傷焦點；SIRT2 敲低損害同源重組修復。在方向性上，SIRT2 以酶性方式啟用 BRCA1 進行修復。這將細胞質和核中的 SIRT2 與基因組穩定性聯繫起來，並揭示了 SIRT2 透過 DNA 修復保真度實現的腫瘤抑制功能。透過去乙醯化促進 BRCA1-BARD1 異源二聚化，SIRT2 支持同源重組機制的組裝。因此 SIRT2 的缺失損害雙鏈斷裂修復，可能導致基因組不穩定和癌症易感性。

source_document: SIRT2.md

subject: BRCA1 deficiency

context.en-US: Loss of BRCA1 triggers increased autophagy as a compensatory survival mechanism in breast and ovarian cancers, buffering the viability impact of defective homologous recombination. Directionally, BRCA1 deficiency sits upstream of autophagic upregulation. This metabolic rewiring can be co-opted by tumors to survive despite genome instability, and it connects genome-maintenance failure to lysosomal clearance pathways. Because autophagy supports the survival of BRCA-deficient cells, combining PARP inhibitors with autophagy inhibitors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy. The compensatory autophagy illustrates how cancer cells adapt to DNA-repair defects.
context.zh-TW: BRCA1 的缺失觸發自噬增加作為乳腺和卵巢癌中的代償性存活機制，緩衝同源重組缺陷對細胞活性的影響。在方向性上，BRCA1 缺陷位於自噬上調的上游。這種代謝重編程可被腫瘤利用在基因組不穩定的情況下存活，將基因組維護失敗與溶酶體清除途徑聯繫起來。由於自噬支持 BRCA 缺陷細胞的存活，正在探索將 PARP 抑制劑與自噬抑制劑結合的治療策略。代償性自噬說明了癌細胞如何適應 DNA 修復缺陷。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: BRCA1 mutation
