Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of restored platinum sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells. By increasing the vulnerability of these cells to cisplatin, SIRT2 may help overcome platinum resistance, a major obstacle in ovarian cancer treatment. This suggests that strategies to augment SIRT2 activity could improve the efficacy of cisplatin-based therapy in resistant disease.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2的過表達顯著增強順鉑耐藥性對應卵巢癌細胞對順鉑的敏感性。方向上，SIRT2位於耐藥卵巢癌細胞中鉑敏感性恢復的上游。透過增加這些細胞對順鉑的脆弱性，SIRT2可能有助於克服鉑耐藥性，這是卵巢癌治療中的主要障礙。這表明增強SIRT2活性的策略可能提高耐藥性疾病中順鉑基治療的效果。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 expression suppresses the expression and acetylation of high-mobility group box 1 protein, thereby inhibiting migration, invasion, and angiogenesis of ovarian cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of reduced HMGB1-driven metastatic and angiogenic programs. By dampening HMGB1, SIRT1 limits the invasive and blood-supply-supporting behaviors of ovarian cancer cells, supporting a tumor-suppressive role and identifying the SIRT1-HMGB1 axis as a candidate therapeutic target in ovarian cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1的表達抑制高遷移率族盒1蛋白（HMGB1）的表達和乙醯化，從而抑制卵巢癌細胞的遷移、侵襲和血管新生。方向上，SIRT1位於HMGB1驅動的轉移和血管新生程序減少的上游。透過抑制HMGB1，SIRT1限制了卵巢癌細胞的侵襲性和血液供應支持行為，支持腫瘤抑制角色，並將SIRT1-HMGB1軸確定為卵巢癌中的候選治療靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT1
object: endometrial cancer growth and cisplatin resistance

context.en-US: SIRT1 promotes the growth and cisplatin resistance of endometrial cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of increased tumor-cell survival and reduced sensitivity to cisplatin in endometrial cancer. By supporting proliferative and survival programs, SIRT1 enables endometrial cancer cells to grow and to withstand platinum-based chemotherapy. This identifies SIRT1 as a potential therapeutic target for improving endometrial cancer treatment outcomes.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1促進子宮內膜癌細胞的生長和順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT1位於子宮內膜癌中腫瘤細胞存活增加和順鉑敏感性降低的上游。透過支持增殖性和存活程序，SIRT1使子宮內膜癌細胞能够生長並承受鉑基化療。這將SIRT1確定為改善子宮內膜癌治療結果的潛在治療靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT2
object: endometrial cancer stemness and chemoresistance via MEK/ERK

context.en-US: SIRT2 promotes cell stemness and activates the MEK/ERK signaling pathway while repressing chemosensitivity in endometrial cancer. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of stem-like phenotypes and MEK/ERK-dependent survival in endometrial cancer cells. By enhancing stemness and ERK signaling, SIRT2 supports tumor self-renewal and reduces responsiveness to chemotherapy. This makes SIRT2 inhibition a potential strategy to sensitize endometrial cancer to treatment.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2促進細胞幹性並活化MEK/ERK訊號通路，同時抑制子宮內膜癌的化療敏感性。方向上，SIRT2位於子宮內膜癌細胞中幹細胞樣表型和MEK/ERK依賴性存活的上游。透過增強幹性和ERK訊號，SIRT2支持腫瘤自我更新並降低對化療的反應性。這使SIRT2抑制成為使子宮內膜癌對治療敏感的潛在策略。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT1 inhibition
object: glioma sensitivity to temozolomide via ROS

context.en-US: SIRT1 inhibition increases the sensitivity of glioma cells to temozolomide through facilitation of intracellular reactive oxygen species generation. Directionally, SIRT1 inhibition sits upstream of elevated ROS and enhanced drug-induced cell death in glioma. By blocking SIRT1's protective anti-oxidant activity, glioma cells accumulate ROS that sensitize them to temozolomide, the standard chemotherapy for glioblastoma. Combining SIRT1 inhibition with temozolomide may therefore improve treatment efficacy in malignant glioma.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1抑制透過促進細胞內活性氧的產生來增加膠質瘤細胞對替莫唑胺的敏感性。方向上，SIRT1抑制位於膠質瘤中ROS升高和藥物誘導的細胞死亡增強的上游。透過阻斷SIRT1的保護性抗氧化活性，膠質瘤細胞積累ROS，使其對替莫唑胺（膠質母細胞瘤的標準化療藥物）敏感。因此將SIRT1抑制與替莫唑胺結合可能改善惡性膠質瘤的治療效果。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT3 overexpression
object: tamoxifen sensitivity in MTR-3 breast cancer cells

context.en-US: SIRT3 overexpression in the breast cancer cell line MTR-3 reduces the sensitivity of the resistant cells to tamoxifen. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of diminished responsiveness to endocrine therapy in breast cancer cells. By lowering tamoxifen sensitivity, SIRT3 may contribute to anti-estrogen resistance, complicating endocrine treatment of breast cancer. This is counterbalanced by SIRT4, which enhances tamoxifen sensitivity, highlighting opposing sirtuin functions in endocrine-resistant breast cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3在乳腺癌細胞系MTR-3中的過表達降低了耐藥細胞對Tamoxifen的敏感性。方向上，SIRT3位於乳腺癌細胞中內分泌療法反應性降低的上游。透過降低Tamoxifen敏感性，SIRT3可能促成抗雌激素耐藥性，使乳腺癌的內分泌治療變得複雜。這與增強Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT4相平衡，突顯了內分泌耐藥性乳腺癌中sirtuin的對立功能。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT4

context.en-US: SIRT4 enhances the tamoxifen sensitivity of breast cancer cells by inhibiting the STAT3 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restored endocrine responsiveness in breast cancer. By suppressing STAT3 signaling, SIRT4 makes breast cancer cells more vulnerable to tamoxifen, in contrast to SIRT3 overexpression, which reduces tamoxifen sensitivity. This positions SIRT4 as a potential enhancer of anti-estrogen therapy efficacy in breast cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT4透過抑制STAT3訊號通路增強乳腺癌細胞的Tamoxifen敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於乳腺癌中內分泌反應性恢復的上游。透過抑制STAT3訊號，SIRT4使乳腺癌細胞更容易受到Tamoxifen的影響，與降低Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT3過表達形成對比。這將SIRT4定位為乳腺癌中抗雌激素療法效果的潛在增強因子。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: AMPK activation
object: SIRT1 activity in triple-negative breast cancer

context.en-US: AMPK activation reduces the expression of the oncogenic protein metadherin through enhanced SIRT1 activity, acting independently of GSK-3β in triple-negative breast cancer. Directionally, AMPK activation sits upstream of SIRT1-driven repression of metadherin. Because metadherin promotes cancer progression, metastasis, and chemoresistance, its downregulation via the AMPK-SIRT1 axis represents a tumor-suppressive mechanism in triple-negative breast cancer.
context.zh-TW: AMPK活化透過增強SIRT1活性來降低致癌蛋白metadherin的表達，在三陰性乳腺癌中不依賴GSK-3β。方向上，AMPK活化位於SIRT1驅動的metadherin抑制的上游。由於metadherin促進癌症進展、轉移和化療耐藥性，其透過AMPK-SIRT1軸的下調代表了三陰性乳腺癌中的一種腫瘤抑制機制。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT7 depletion

context.en-US: SIRT7 depletion inhibits tumor growth by activating p38/MAPK signaling in breast cancer. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of p38/MAPK pathway activation, which suppresses tumor-cell expansion. Because SIRT7 normally restrains this growth-limiting signaling, its depletion unleashes p38/MAPK activity and curbs tumor growth. This positions SIRT7 as a tumor-promoting factor in breast cancer and identifies the p38/MAPK pathway as a downstream mediator.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7耗竭透過活化p38/MAPK訊號通路在乳腺癌中抑制腫瘤生長。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於p38/MAPK通路活化的上游，後者抑制腫瘤細胞擴增。因為SIRT7通常限制此生長限制性訊號，其耗竭釋放p38/MAPK活性並抑制腫瘤生長。這將SIRT7定位為乳腺癌中的促腫瘤因子，並將p38/MAPK通路確定為下游介導因子。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT1 knockdown

context.en-US: Pharmacological targeting or RNAi-mediated knockdown of SIRT1 inhibits cell growth and sensitizes acute myeloid leukemia cells to tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of enhanced drug sensitivity in AML. By restraining SIRT1-driven survival, AML cells become more responsive to tyrosine kinase inhibitors, suggesting that combining SIRT1 inhibition with TKI therapy could improve leukemia treatment outcomes.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1的藥理學靶向或RNAi介導的沉默抑制細胞生長並使急性骨髓性白血病細胞對酪氨酸激酶抑制劑治療敏感。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於AML中藥物敏感性增強的上游。透過抑制SIRT1驅動的存活，AML細胞對酪氨酸激酶抑制劑變得更加敏感，表明將SIRT1抑制與TKI治療結合可能改善白血病治療結果。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: shSIRT6-induced DNA repair deficiency

context.en-US: SIRT6 knockdown-induced DNA repair deficiencies are potently synergistic with NAMPT targeting in acute myeloid leukemia treatment, showing promising in vivo efficacy compared with monotherapy. Directionally, SIRT6 loss-driven DNA repair defects and NAMPT inhibition cooperate to kill AML cells. This dual strategy exploits two vulnerabilities, offering a rationale for combination-based treatments that outperform single-agent therapy in acute myeloid leukemia.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6敲低誘導的DNA修復缺陷在急性骨髓性白血病治療中與NAMPT靶向具有強大的協同作用，與單一療法相比顯示出有前景的體內療效。方向上，SIRT6缺失驅動的DNA修復缺陷和NAMPT抑制協同殺傷AML細胞。這種雙重策略利用兩個脆弱性，為在急性骨髓性白血病中優於單一藥物治療的組合治療提供了理論基礎。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 enables HPV-infected cervical cancer cells to continue growing by nullifying absent in melanoma 2 inflammasome-mediated immunity. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of suppressed inflammasome signaling and immune clearance in cervical cancer. By inactivating the AIM2 inflammasome, SIRT1 helps HPV-infected cervical cancer cells evade innate immune surveillance, supporting their continued growth. This positions the SIRT1-AIM2 axis as a potential immunotherapeutic target in HPV-driven cervical cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1使HPV感染的子宮頸癌細胞能够透過消除黑色素瘤缺失2（AIM2）發炎小體介導的免疫來繼續生長。方向上，SIRT1位於子宮頸癌中發炎小體訊號和免疫清除抑制的上游。透過使AIM2發炎小體失活，SIRT1幫助HPV感染的子宮頸癌細胞逃避先天免疫監視，支持其持續生長。這將SIRT1-AIM2軸確定為HPV驅動的子宮頸癌中的潛在免疫治療靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 contributes to the reprogramming of fatty acid synthesis by upregulating acetyl-coA carboxylase 1 to promote de novo lipogenesis through SIRT3 deacetylation, thereby promoting the invasion and metastasis of cervical cancer cells. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of ACC1-driven de novo lipogenesis and metastatic behavior in cervical cancer. By enhancing lipid synthesis, SIRT3 supports the invasive and metastatic capabilities of cervical cancer cells, identifying SIRT3-ACC1 lipogenesis as a potential therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3透過上調乙醯CoA羧化酶1（ACC1）來重編程脂肪酸合成，透過SIRT3去乙醯化促進從頭脂肪生成，從而促進子宮頸癌細胞的侵襲和轉移。方向上，SIRT3位於子宮頸癌中ACC1驅動的從頭脂肪生成和轉移行為的上游。透過增強脂質合成，SIRT3支持子宮頸癌細胞的侵襲和轉移能力，將SIRT3-ACC1脂肪生成確定為潛在的治療靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: MHY2245

context.en-US: MHY2245, a new SIRT1 inhibitor, exerts antitumor activity against ovarian cancer cells by blocking the pyruvate kinase M2/mTOR pathway. Directionally, MHY2245 sits upstream of suppressed PKM2/mTOR signaling and reduced ovarian cancer cell survival. By inhibiting SIRT1 and consequently the PKM2/mTOR pathway, MHY2245 curbs tumor-cell metabolism and growth. This supports SIRT1 inhibition as a therapeutic strategy in ovarian cancer, where SIRT1 inhibition of HMGB1 also suppresses metastasis and angiogenesis.
context.zh-TW: MHY2245是一種新型SIRT1抑制劑，透過阻斷丙酮酸激酶M2/mTOR通路對卵巢癌細胞發揮抗腫瘤活性。方向上，MHY2245位於PKM2/mTOR訊號抑制和卵巢癌細胞存活降低的上游。透過抑制SIRT1及隨後的PKM2/mTOR通路，MHY2245限制腫瘤細胞的代謝和生長。這支持SIRT1抑制作為卵巢癌的治療策略，其中SIRT1對HMGB1的抑制也抑制了轉移和血管新生。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT5 loss

context.en-US: SIRT5 expression is directly correlated with favorable prognosis in pancreatic cancer, as SIRT5 loss promotes glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase 1 acetylation, thus promoting cell proliferation by enhancing glutamine and glutathione metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of GOT1 deacetylation that restrains pancreatic cancer growth. When SIRT5 is lost, GOT1 acetylation rises, boosting glutamine and glutathione metabolism to drive proliferation. This identifies SIRT5 as a tumor suppressor in pancreatic cancer whose levels could inform prognosis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5表達與胰腺癌的良好預後直接相關，因為SIRT5缺失促進穀草轉氨酶1（GOT1）乙醯化，從而透過增強穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝促進細胞增殖。方向上，SIRT5位於抑制胰腺癌生長的GOT1去乙醯化的上游。當SIRT5缺失時，GOT1乙醯化升高，促進穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝以驅動增殖。這將SIRT5確定為胰腺癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其水平可能為預後提供資訊。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT6 upregulation

context.en-US: Upregulation of SIRT6 by the tumor suppressor KLF10 activity influences glycolysis, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, and distant metastasis of pancreatic cancer cells. Directionally, KLF10-driven SIRT6 upregulation sits upstream of altered metabolic and invasive behaviors in pancreatic cancer. By modulating glycolysis and EMT, SIRT6 shapes the aggressiveness and metastatic capacity of pancreatic cancer cells, indicating that the KLF10-SIRT6 axis may serve as a therapeutic or prognostic target in pancreatic cancer.
context.zh-TW: 腫瘤抑制因子KLF10活性上調的SIRT6影響胰腺癌細胞的糖解作用、上皮-間質轉化和遠端轉移。方向上，KLF10驅動的SIRT6上調位於胰腺癌中代謝和侵襲行為改變的上游。透過調節糖解作用和EMT，SIRT6塑造胰腺癌細胞的侵襲性和轉移能力，表明KLF10-SIRT6軸可能作為胰腺癌中的治療或預後靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 can facilitate chemoresistance of pancreatic cancer cells by regulating their adaptive response to chemotherapy-induced stress. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of stress adaptation and reduced drug sensitivity in pancreatic cancer. By helping tumor cells adapt to chemotherapy-induced stress, SIRT1 enables pancreatic cancer cells to survive cytotoxic treatment. This identifies SIRT1 as a potential target to overcome chemoresistance in pancreatic cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1可以透過調節胰腺癌細胞對化療誘導壓力的適應性反應來促進化療耐藥性。方向上，SIRT1位於胰腺癌中壓力適應和藥物敏感性降低的上游。透過幫助腫瘤細胞適應化療誘導的壓力，SIRT1使胰腺癌細胞能够在細胞毒治療中存活。這將SIRT1確定為克服胰腺癌化療耐藥性的潛在靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: SIRT5

context.en-US: SIRT5 can promote cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner via regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of reduced ROS, diminished DNA damage, and enhanced survival of ovarian cancer cells treated with cisplatin. By activating Nrf2/HO-1-dependent antioxidant defense, SIRT5 protects ovarian cancer cells from platinum-induced damage, contributing to chemoresistance. This contrasts with SIRT2, whose overexpression enhances cisplatin sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5可以透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷來促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於接受順鉑治療的卵巢癌細胞中ROS降低、DNA損傷減少和存活增強的上游。透過活化Nrf2/HO-1依賴性抗氧化防禦，SIRT5保護卵巢癌細胞免受鉑誘導的損傷，促成化療耐藥性。這與過表達增強耐藥卵巢癌細胞順鉑敏感性的SIRT2形成對比。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md

subject: Sirtuin deacetylation reaction

context.en-US: Sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation couples the cleavage of NAD+ to the removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues. Each round of deacetylation converts one molecule of NAD+ into nicotinamide (NAM) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. NAM then acts as an end-product inhibitor of sirtuins by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to the NAD+ site, thereby blocking further NAD+ hydrolysis. This product-based feedback links cellular NAD+ status and NAM levels directly to sirtuin enzymatic output.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuin催化的去乙醯化反應將NAD+的裂解與賴氨酸殘基上乙醯基的移除耦合。每輪去乙醯化將一分子NAD+轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM）和O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。NAM隨後作為sirtuin的末端產物抑制劑，結合到與NAD+位點相鄰的保守口袋，從而阻斷進一步的NAD+水解。這種基於產物的反饋直接將細胞NAD+狀態和NAM水平與sirtuin酵素輸出聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: NAM (nicotinamide)

context.en-US: Nicotinamide is a known potent inhibitor of several classes of ribosylase enzymes that require NAD for their activity, as well as of SIRT1, the class III NAD+-dependent histone deacetylase. NAM acts as an end-product noncompetitive inhibitor of SIRT1 by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to NAD+, thereby blocking NAD+ hydrolysis. Because NAM is generated by the sirtuin reaction itself, it provides a built-in negative feedback mechanism that can curtail SIRT1 activity when local nicotinamide accumulates.
context.zh-TW: 菸鹼醯胺是多種需要NAD的核糖基酶以及SIRT1（第III類NAD+依賴性組蛋白去乙醯酶）的已知強效抑制劑。NAM透過結合到與NAD+相鄰的保守口袋作為SIRT1的末端產物非競爭性抑制劑，從而阻斷NAD+水解。由於NAM是sirtuin反應本身產生的，它提供了一個內建的負反饋機制，可以在局部菸鹼醯胺積累時限制SIRT1活性。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: Sirtuins

context.en-US: The sirtuin family has been classified into five distinct classes (I-IV and U) based on a phylogenetic study of sirtuins from a wide range of prokaryotes and eukaryotes. SIR-2.1, Drosophila melanogaster Sir2 (D.mel1), Hst1, and SIRT1 all belong to subclass Ia. Subclass Ib includes Hst2, D.mel2, and various fungi and protozoa sirtuins along with SIRT2 and SIRT3. SIRT4 and SIRT5 belong to classes II and III, respectively. SIRT6 and SIRT7 belong to Class IV, which includes only eukaryotic sirtuins. Sir2 homologues from bacteria with undifferentiated motifs constitute class U.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuin家族根據對廣泛原核和真核生物sirtuin的系統發育研究被分為五個不同的類別（I-IV和U）。SIR-2.1、黑腹果蠅Sir2（D.mel1）、Hst1和SIRT1都屬於Ia亞類。Ib亞類包括Hst2、D.mel2以及各種真菌和原生動物sirtuin，連同SIRT2和SIRT3。SIRT4和SIRT5分別屬於第II和第III類。SIRT6和SIRT7屬於第IV類，僅包括真核sirtuin。具有未分化基序的細菌Sir2同源物構成U類。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: CobB

context.en-US: The first bacterial sirtuin was found in Salmonella enterica and was named CobB due to its involvement in cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic catabolism. CobB demonstrates that sirtuins are not restricted to eukaryotes but are also present in prokaryotes, where they regulate various metabolic pathways. In bacteria one or two sirtuins are typically found, and CobB serves as the founding example of prokaryotic sirtuin biology.
context.zh-TW: 第一個細菌sirtuin在腸炎沙門氏菌中被發現，由於其參與鈷胺素生物合成和丙酸分解代謝而被命名為CobB。CobB證明了sirtuin並非僅限於真核生物，也存在於原核生物中，在那裡它們調節各種代謝途徑。在細菌中通常發現一到兩個sirtuin，CobB作為原核sirtuin生物學的奠基範例。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 activation enhances homologous recombination, a function that could help to decrease tumours by stabilising chromosomes and/or extending the lifespan by maintaining rDNA arrays. In human cells SIRT1 activation enhances homologous recombination. SIRT1 also contributes to telomere maintenance and augments global homologous recombination, linking nuclear sirtuin activity to genome stability and longevity.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1活化增強同源重組，此功能可能透過穩定染色體和/或維持rDNA陣列的壽命來幫助減少腫瘤或延長壽命。在人類細胞中，SIRT1活化增強同源重組。SIRT1也有助於端粒維護並增強整體同源重組，將核sirtuin活性與基因組穩定性和長壽聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 modulates the activity of DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT1) by deacetylating it. Deacetylation of DNMT1 at certain lysine residues improves its methyltransferase activity, alters its transcription suppression activity, and impairs its ability to silence tumour suppressor genes. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of DNMT1 enzymatic activity and thus influences DNA methylation patterns and gene silencing, providing a direct molecular link between sirtuins and the epigenetic machinery.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1透過去乙醯化來調節DNA甲基轉移酶1（DNMT1）的活性。DNMT1在特定賴氨酸殘基的去乙醯化改善了其甲基轉移酶活性，改變了其轉錄抑制活性，並損害了其沉默腫瘤抑制基因的能力。方向上，SIRT1位於DNMT1酵素活性的上游，從而影響DNA甲基化模式和基因沉默，提供了sirtuin與表觀遺傳機制之間的直接分子聯繫。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 controls UV-induced DNA damage repair by deacetylating xeroderma pigmentosum group A (XPA), a protein that is required for the nucleotide excision repair pathway to function properly. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of XPA activity and thereby of nucleotide excision repair. This places SIRT1 in the DNA damage response network and links sirtuin function to the maintenance of genomic integrity following environmental genotoxic stress.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1透過去乙醯化著色性乾皮症A組（XPA）蛋白來控制紫外線誘導的DNA損傷修復，XPA是核苷酸切除修復途徑正常運作所需的蛋白質。方向上，SIRT1位於XPA活性的上游，從而位於核苷酸切除修復的上游。這將SIRT1置於DNA損傷反應網路中，並將sirtuin功能與環境基因毒性壓力後基因組完整性的維護聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT1
object: oxidative stress and age-related NAD+ decline

context.en-US: SIRT1 has a significant role in oxidative stress response. Increased SIRT1 protein levels counteract oxidative stress and the ageing-related decline in NAD+ levels. In elderly humans SIRT1 protein expression shows a remarkable age-related increase against oxidative stress. Directionally, SIRT1 sits upstream of cellular defence against oxidative damage, and its induction appears to be a compensatory anti-ageing response that mitigates the consequences of declining NAD+ availability.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1在氧化壓力反應中具有重要作用。增加的SIRT1蛋白水平對抗氧化壓力和與年齡相關的NAD+水平下降。在老年人中，SIRT1蛋白表達顯示出對抗氧化壓力的顯著與年齡相關的增加。方向上，SIRT1位於對氧化損傷的細胞防禦的上游，其誘導似乎是一種補償性的抗老化反應，減輕了NAD+可用性下降的後果。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT1 downregulation

context.en-US: Downregulation of SIRT1 was found to be important in the senescence of different types of endothelial cells. Directionally, SIRT1 loss sits upstream of cellular senescence in the vascular endothelium. Because SIRT1 normally promotes stress resistance and genomic stability, its decline in endothelial cells is linked to the senescent phenotype. This positions SIRT1 as a potential target for preserving endothelial function and preventing vascular ageing.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1的下調在不同類型內皮細胞的衰老中被發現具有重要意義。方向上，SIRT1缺失位於血管內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT1通常促進壓力抗性和基因組穩定性，其在內皮細胞中的下降與衰老表型相關。這將SIRT1確定為維持內皮功能和預防血管老化的潛在靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: By targeting glycolytic enzymes, SIRT2 controls metabolic reprogramming during induced pluripotency. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of the metabolic switch from oxidative to glycolytic metabolism that accompanies reprogramming of somatic cells toward pluripotency. This metabolic control is essential for the establishment and function of primed human pluripotent stem cells, linking sirtuin activity to cell fate determination and stem cell biology.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2透過靶向糖解酶來控制誘導多能性期間的代謝重編程。方向上，SIRT2位於伴隨體細胞向多能性重編程的從氧化代謝到糖解代謝的代謝轉換的上游。這種代謝控制對於已啟動的人類多能幹細胞的建立和功能至關重要，將sirtuin活性與細胞命運決定和幹細胞生物學聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 regulates HIF-1 activity, which is important for tumour hypoxia responses. HIF-1 protein stability and transcriptional activity are both negatively influenced by SIRT2, with SIRT2-mediated deacetylation necessary for HIF-1α destabilisation and the tumour cell hypoxia response. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of reduced HIF-1α abundance and activity, thereby restraining hypoxia-driven transcriptional programs in tumour cells.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2調節HIF-1活性，這對腫瘤缺氧反應很重要。HIF-1蛋白穩定性和轉錄活性都受到SIRT2的負向影響，SIRT2介導的去乙醯化對於HIF-1α不穩定化和腫瘤細胞缺氧反應是必要的。方向上，SIRT2位於HIF-1α豐度和活性降低的上游，從而抑制腫瘤細胞中的缺氧驅動的轉錄程序。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT2
object: NSCLC cell lines and metastatic melanoma

context.en-US: The level of SIRT2 is upregulated in non-small cell lung cancer cell lines and in metastatic human melanoma tissues compared to healthy cells and tissues. Directionally, SIRT2 expression is increased in these aggressive cancer contexts. In metastatic melanoma, SIRT2 levels are increased compared to tumours of early stage, suggesting involvement of SIRT2 in the advancement of metastatic disease. SIRT2 therefore represents a potential biomarker and drug target in NSCLC and metastatic melanoma.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2在非小細胞肺癌細胞系和轉移性人類黑色素瘤組織中與健康細胞和組織相比表現為上調。方向上，SIRT2表達在這些侵襲性癌症環境中增加。在轉移性黑色素瘤中，SIRT2水平與早期腫瘤相比增加，表明SIRT2參與了轉移性疾病的進展。因此SIRT2在NSCLC和轉移性黑色素瘤中代表了潛在的生物標誌物和藥物靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 could be a promising drug target for acute promyelocytic leukaemia therapy. Directionally, SIRT2 activity sits upstream of leukaemia cell survival and differentiation programs. Pharmacological modulation of SIRT2 is therefore being explored as a therapeutic strategy in this haematological malignancy, potentially by restoring differentiation or promoting death of leukaemic blasts.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2可能是急性前骨髓性白血病治療的一個有前景的藥物靶點。方向上，SIRT2活性位於白血病細胞存活和分化程序的上游。因此SIRT2的藥理學調節正在被探索為此血液惡性腫瘤的治療策略，可能是透過恢復分化或促進白血病母細胞的死亡。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 has a role in neurodegeneration and protects neural cells from oxidative damage caused by ageing and disease. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of neuronal resilience against oxidative stress. Although SIRT2 is overexpressed in neurodegenerative disorders such as Parkinson's disease, its ability to shield neurons from oxidative injury suggests a protective function in specific contexts, and SIRT2 remains a candidate target for neuroprotective strategies.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2在神經退行性疾病中具有作用，並保護神經細胞免受衰老和疾病引起的氧化損傷。方向上，SIRT2位於神經元對氧化壓力的韌性的上游。儘管SIRT2在帕金森氏症等神經退行性疾病中過表達，但它保護神經元免受氧化損傷的能力表明在特定環境中的保護功能，SIRT2仍然是神經保護策略的候選靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT3
object: N-terminal 101 residues by mitochondrial processing peptidase

context.en-US: The full-length SIRT3 protein is enzymatically inactive and contains a mitochondrial targeting domain at its N-terminus. Mitochondrial matrix processing peptidase cleaves the N-terminal 101 residues, which then activates the enzyme. Directionally, proteolytic processing sits upstream of SIRT3 catalytic activity within the mitochondrial matrix. This maturation step ensures that SIRT3 functions only after import into mitochondria, where it deacetylates metabolic enzymes.
context.zh-TW: 全長SIRT3蛋白在酵素上是不活性的，其N端包含一個粒線體靶向結構域。粒線體基質加工肽酶切除N端101個殘基，從而活化該酶。方向上，蛋白水解加工位於粒線體基質中SIRT3催化活性的上游。此成熟步驟確保SIRT3僅在輸入粒線體後才發揮功能，在那裡它去乙醯化代謝酶。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT3 deacetylase activity

context.en-US: The deacetylase activity of SIRT3 is required for viral suppression, and during infection SIRT3 keeps membrane potential and mitochondrial pH stable. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of mitochondrial homeostasis during viral infection, supporting antiviral defence. By maintaining mitochondrial function under infection-induced stress, SIRT3 protects cells from viral damage and restricts viral replication.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3的去乙醯酶活性對病毒抑制是必需的，在感染期間SIRT3保持膜電位和粒線體pH的穩定。方向上，SIRT3位於病毒感染期間粒線體恆定的上游，支持抗病毒防禦。透過在感染誘導的壓力下維持粒線體功能，SIRT3保護細胞免受病毒損傷並限制病毒複製。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Through the p53 pathway, SIRT3 prevents dysfunction and senescence caused by high glucose levels in endothelial cells by partially abrogating p53 activity. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of dampened p53 signalling and thereby of protection against glucose-induced endothelial senescence. This links mitochondrial sirtuin activity to vascular health and identifies SIRT3 as a potential target for preventing diabetic endothelial dysfunction.
context.zh-TW: 透過p53通路，SIRT3透過部分消除p53活性來預防高葡萄糖水平在內皮細胞中引起的功能障礙和衰老。方向上，SIRT3位於p53訊號減弱的上游，從而保護免受葡萄糖誘導的內皮衰老。這將粒線體sirtuin活性與血管健康聯繫起來，並將SIRT3確定為預防糖尿病內皮功能障礙的潛在靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 could also be used as a marker for colon cancer. In colon cancer, SIRT3 deficiency reduces cell proliferation, invasion, and migration while increasing apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT3 expression levels sit upstream of colon cancer behaviour, with loss of SIRT3 restraining tumour aggressiveness. SIRT3 therefore has potential diagnostic and prognostic utility in colorectal cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3也可以作為結腸癌的標誌物。在結腸癌中，SIRT3缺乏減少細胞增殖、侵襲和遷移，同時增加凋亡。方向上，SIRT3表達水平位於結腸癌行為的上游，SIRT3缺失限制腫瘤侵襲性。因此SIRT3在大腸直腸癌中具有潛在的診斷和預後價值。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 stops mitochondrial reactive oxygen species generation, which inhibits HIF-1α and tumour growth. When SIRT3 is overexpressed, it resists the growth of established cancer cell lines. SIRT3 also prevents cancer cell metabolic reprogramming by destabilising HIF1α. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced mitochondrial ROS and HIF-1α stabilisation, thereby opposing the hypoxic and metabolic adaptations that support tumour growth.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3阻止粒線體活性氧的產生，這抑制HIF-1α和腫瘤生長。當SIRT3過表達時，它抵抗已建立癌細胞系的生長。SIRT3也透過使HIF1α不穩定化來防止癌細胞代謝重編程。方向上，SIRT3位於粒線體ROS降低和HIF-1α穩定化抑制的上游，從而對抗支持腫瘤生長的缺氧和代謝適應。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT3 activation

context.en-US: SIRT3 activation prevents amyotrophic lateral sclerosis motor neurons from developing metabolic abnormalities. ALS motor neurons exhibit hallmark metabolic defects including decreased mitochondrial respiration and increased glycolysis, which arise from systemic NAD+ depletion. SIRT3 activation and/or NAD+ supplementation has been discovered as a treatment for disease phenotypes in both sporadic and familial ALS, restoring normal mitochondrial metabolism and rescuing motor neuron viability.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3活化防止肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症（ALS）運動神經元出現代謝異常。ALS運動神經元表現出標誌性的代謝缺陷，包括粒線體呼吸降低和糖解作用增加，這些源於全身性NAD+耗竭。SIRT3活化和/或NAD+補充已被發現可治療散發性和家族性ALS的疾病表型，恢復正常的粒線體代謝並挽救運動神經元存活能力。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT4

context.en-US: SIRT4 plays a crucial role in mitotic cell division regulation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of proper cell cycle progression and mitotic fidelity. In addition to its roles in glutamine metabolism and tumor suppression, SIRT4 contributes to the orderly execution of mitosis, extending the functional repertoire of this mitochondrial sirtuin beyond metabolism.
context.zh-TW: SIRT4在有絲分裂細胞分裂調節中發揮關鍵作用。方向上，SIRT4位於正常的細胞週期進展和有絲分裂保真度的上游。除了其在穀氨醯胺代謝和腫瘤抑制中的角色外，SIRT4還有助於有絲分裂的有序執行，將此粒線體sirtuin的功能譜擴展到代謝之外。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT4
object: NSCLC, colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer

context.en-US: SIRT4 is an effective tumour suppressor in non-small cell lung cancer cells, human colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restrained tumour growth across multiple cancer types, in part by inhibiting glutamine metabolism and modulating mitochondrial dynamics. Low SIRT4 expression thereby permits tumorigenic behaviour, and SIRT4 represents a prognostic and therapeutic target in these cancers.
context.zh-TW: SIRT4在非小細胞肺癌細胞、人類大腸直腸癌、神經母細胞瘤和胃癌中是有效的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT4位於多種癌症類型中腫瘤生長抑制的上游，部分透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝和調節粒線體動力學。因此低SIRT4表達允許致瘤行為，SIRT4在這些癌症中代表了預後和治療靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT4
object: hepatocellular carcinoma and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma

context.en-US: Expression of SIRT4 is considerably downregulated in hepatocellular carcinoma tumour tissues and in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Lower expression of SIRT4 promotes esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma development. Directionally, loss of SIRT4 sits upstream of tumorigenic progression in these cancers, and its reduced expression is associated with poorer outcomes, supporting SIRT4 as a biomarker and tumor suppressor in HCC and esophageal cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT4的表達在肝細胞癌腫瘤組織和食道鱗狀細胞癌中顯著下調。SIRT4的較低表達促進食道鱗狀細胞癌和肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT4缺失位於這些癌症中腫瘤發生進展的上游，其降低的表達與較差的預後相關，支持SIRT4作為HCC和食道癌中的生物標誌物和腫瘤抑制因子。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT4
object: endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and osteoarthritis

context.en-US: In humans, SIRT4 inhibits inflammation in endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and in osteoarthritis. SIRT4 suppresses the inflammatory response and oxidative stress in osteoarthritis. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of dampened inflammatory signalling in vascular endothelium and joint tissue. By restraining inflammation and oxidative stress, SIRT4 exerts protective effects in osteoarthritis and may help preserve endothelial function.
context.zh-TW: 在人類中，SIRT4抑制臍靜脈內皮細胞和骨關節炎中的發炎。SIRT4在骨關節炎中抑制發炎反應和氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT4位於血管內皮和關節組織中發炎訊號減弱的上游。透過抑制發炎和氧化壓力，SIRT4在骨關節炎中發揮保護作用，可能有助於維持內皮功能。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT4

context.en-US: As an outcome of cellular stresses, SIRT4 controls PTEN stability via the insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE). Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of PTEN protein abundance through IDE-mediated degradation. Because PTEN is a key tumour suppressor and negative regulator of PI3K/Akt signalling, SIRT4-dependent control of PTEN stability links mitochondrial sirtuin activity to oncogenic signalling under stress conditions.
context.zh-TW: 作為細胞壓力的結果，SIRT4透過胰島素降解酶（IDE）控制PTEN的穩定性。方向上，SIRT4透過IDE介導的降解位於PTEN蛋白豐度的上游。由於PTEN是關鍵的腫瘤抑制因子和PI3K/Akt訊號的負向調節因子，SIRT4依賴性的PTEN穩定性控制將粒線體sirtuin活性與壓力條件下的致癌訊號聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT4

context.en-US: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) to mediate retrograde signalling. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cellular energy sensing and mitochondrial-to-nuclear communication. By modulating ATP levels and engaging AMPK-mediated retrograde signalling, SIRT4 helps the cell adapt its nuclear gene expression to mitochondrial metabolic status under conditions of energy stress.
context.zh-TW: SIRT4控制ATP恆定並使用AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）來介導逆行訊號。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞能量感知和粒線體到核通訊的上游。透過調節ATP水平並參與AMPK介導的逆行訊號，SIRT4幫助細胞在能量壓力條件下根據粒線體代謝狀態調整其核基因表達。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT5

context.en-US: In lung epithelial cells, SIRT5-mediated deacetylation of Forkhead protein FOXO3a inhibits apoptosis induced by cigarette smoke extract. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of FOXO3a deacetylation and reduced apoptosis under cigarette smoke stress. By dampening FOXO3a-driven pro-apoptotic signalling, SIRT5 helps lung epithelial cells survive the toxic effects of cigarette smoke, with potential relevance to smoking-related lung pathology.
context.zh-TW: 在肺上皮細胞中，SIRT5介導的Foxhead蛋白FOXO3a的去乙醯化抑制香菸煙霧提取物誘導的凋亡。方向上，SIRT5位於香菸煙霧壓力下FOXO3a去乙醯化和凋亡減少的上游。透過抑制FOXO3a驅動的促凋亡訊號，SIRT5幫助肺上皮細胞在香菸煙霧的毒性作用下存活，可能與吸煙相關的肺部病理相關。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT5
object: breast tumor, HCC, and NSCLC cells

context.en-US: SIRT5 is important in the growth of breast tumour cells, hepatocellular carcinoma, and human non-small cell lung cancer tissues. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of tumour growth in these cancer types, and its overexpression indicates a poor prognosis in human non-small cell lung cancer. SIRT5 thereby acts as a tumour-promoting factor in breast cancer, HCC, and lung cancer, making it a candidate therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5在乳腺腫瘤細胞、肝細胞癌和人類非小細胞肺癌組織的生長中很重要。方向上，SIRT5位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤生長的上游，其過表達在人類非小細胞肺癌中預示不良預後。因此SIRT5在乳腺癌、HCC和肺癌中作為促腫瘤因子，使其成為候選治療靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT5

context.en-US: SIRT5 is upregulated during cellular transformation and is involved in cancer and its proliferation by desuccinylating serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2). Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SHMT2 sits upstream of enhanced one-carbon metabolism and cancer cell proliferation. By activating SHMT2, SIRT5 supports the biosynthetic demands of proliferating cancer cells, contributing to tumorigenesis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5在細胞轉化期間上調，並透過去琥珀醯化絲氨酸羥甲基轉移酶2（SHMT2）參與癌症及其增殖。方向上，SIRT5對SHMT2的去琥珀醯化位於一碳代謝增強和癌細胞增殖的上游。透過活化SHMT2，SIRT5支持增殖癌細胞的生物合成需求，促成腫瘤發生。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT5 desuccinylation of SDHA
object: clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis

context.en-US: SIRT5-mediated desuccinylation of succinate dehydrogenase A (SDHA) promotes clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis. Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SDHA sits upstream of increased growth of clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumours. By activating SDHA and thereby modulating the TCA cycle, SIRT5 supports the metabolic reprogramming that drives this kidney cancer, identifying SIRT5 as a potential target in ccRCC.
context.zh-TW: SIRT5介導的琥珀酸脫氫酶A（SDHA）去琥珀醯化促進透明細胞腎細胞癌的腫瘤發生。方向上，SIRT5對SDHA的去琥珀醯化位於透明細胞腎細胞癌腫瘤生長增加的上游。透過活化SDHA從而調節TCA循環，SIRT5支持驅動此腎癌的代謝重編程，將SIRT5確定為ccRCC中的潛在靶點。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT5

context.en-US: A finding suggests that in cardiomyocytes, SIRT5 is a key moderator in cell death induced by H2O2. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the cardiomyocyte response to oxidative stress, dampening or modulating hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death. This places SIRT5 in the cardiac stress response network and suggests that modulating SIRT5 activity could influence oxidative injury in the heart.
context.zh-TW: 一項發現表明，在心肌細胞中，SIRT5是H2O2誘導的細胞死亡的關鍵調節因子。方向上，SIRT5位於心肌細胞對氧化壓力反應的上游，抑制或調節過氧化氫誘導的細胞死亡。這將SIRT5置於心臟壓力反應網路中，並表明調節SIRT5活性可能影響心臟的氧化損傷。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT5
object: cellular energy metabolism and AMPK activity under energy stress

context.en-US: As a result of energy stress, SIRT5 modulates cellular energy metabolism and AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of metabolic adaptation and AMPK activation during energy deprivation. By influencing energy metabolism and engaging AMPK signalling, SIRT5 helps cells maintain energy homeostasis under stress conditions, linking mitochondrial deacylation to the cellular energy sensing network.
context.zh-TW: 作為能量壓力的結果，SIRT5調節細胞能量代謝和AMP活化蛋白激酶活性。方向上，SIRT5位於能量剝奪期間代謝適應和AMPK活化的上游。透過影響能量代謝並參與AMPK訊號，SIRT5幫助細胞在壓力條件下維持能量恆定，將粒線體去醯基化與細胞能量感知網路聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: In humans, SIRT6 is necessary to maintain the telomere position effect. SIRT6 was discovered as the first enzyme that modifies histones to regulate the telomere position effect in human cells, a novel role for SIRT6 in the regulation of age-related genome silencing. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of telomeric chromatin silencing, providing a new approach for telomere chromatin silencing and linking SIRT6 to telomere biology and genome stability.
context.zh-TW: 在人類中，SIRT6對於維持端粒位置效應是必要的。SIRT6被發現為第一個修飾組蛋白以調節人類細胞中端粒位置效應的酶，這是SIRT6在調節與年齡相關的基因組沉默方面的新角色。方向上，SIRT6位於端粒染色質沉默的上游，為端粒染色質沉默提供了新的方法，並將SIRT6與端粒生物學和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT6
object: aging and reprogramming of human iPSCs

context.en-US: SIRT6 has a part to play in ageing of human induced pluripotent stem cells as well as their reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of pluripotent stem cell aging dynamics and the efficiency of somatic cell reprogramming. By influencing these processes, SIRT6 links chromatin-based ageing regulation to stem cell biology and regenerative medicine.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6在人類誘導多能幹細胞的老化及其重編程中發揮作用。方向上，SIRT6位於多能幹細胞老化動態和體細胞重編程效率的上游。透過影響這些過程，SIRT6將基於染色質的老化調節與幹細胞生物學和再生醫學聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: Sirtuin 6 inhibits the generation of reactive oxygen species and glycolysis, which decreases the inflammatory response generated by hypoxia in human osteoblasts. This has therapeutic implications in inflammatory bone resorption. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of reduced ROS and glycolysis and thereby of dampened hypoxic inflammation in bone cells. SIRT6 thus protects osteoblasts from hypoxia-induced inflammatory damage.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuin 6抑制活性氧和糖解作用的產生，這降低了缺氧在人類成骨細胞中產生的發炎反應。這對炎性骨吸收具有治療意義。方向上，SIRT6位於活性氧和糖解作用減少的上游，從而位於骨細胞中缺氧發炎的抑制上游。因此SIRT6保護成骨細胞免受缺氧誘導的發炎損傷。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT6 downregulation

context.en-US: Research has shown that senescence of endothelial cells is induced by oxidative stress due to SIRT6 downregulation. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of oxidative stress-driven endothelial senescence. Because SIRT6 normally supports antioxidant defences and DNA repair, its decline leaves endothelial cells vulnerable to oxidative damage and the senescent phenotype, linking SIRT6 to vascular ageing.
context.zh-TW: 研究表明，由於SIRT6下調導致的氧化壓力誘導了內皮細胞的衰老。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於氧化壓力驅動的內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT6通常支持抗氧化防禦和DNA修復，其下降使內皮細胞容易受到氧化損傷和衰老表型的影響，將SIRT6與血管老化聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT6

context.en-US: It has been discovered in humans that SIRT6 interacts with the nuclear factor erythroid-derived 2-like 2 (NRF2) for the protection of mesenchymal stem cells from oxidative damage. SIRT6 safeguards human mesenchymal stem cells from oxidative stress by coactivating NRF2. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of NRF2-dependent antioxidant gene expression and thereby of stem cell survival under oxidative conditions.
context.zh-TW: 在人類中已發現SIRT6與核因子紅系2相關因子2（NRF2）相互作用，保護間充質幹細胞免受氧化損傷。SIRT6透過共活化NRF2來保護人類間充質幹細胞免受氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT6位於NRF2依賴性抗氧化基因表達的上游，從而位於氧化條件下幹細胞存活的上游。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT6 overexpression

context.en-US: Compared to healthy cells, SIRT6 overexpression significantly accelerates apoptosis in tumour cells. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of tumour cell death, preferentially killing cancer cells while sparing healthy cells. This tumour-selective pro-apoptotic activity supports SIRT6 activation as a potential therapeutic strategy against cancers that retain SIRT6 expression.
context.zh-TW: 與健康細胞相比，SIRT6過表達顯著加速腫瘤細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於腫瘤細胞死亡的上游，優先殺傷癌細胞同時保護健康細胞。這種腫瘤選擇性的促凋亡活性支持SIRT6活化作為對抗保留SIRT6表達的癌症的潛在治療策略。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT6 deficiency

context.en-US: Lack of SIRT6 decreases the viability of prostate cancer cells while increasing chemotherapeutic sensitivity. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of reduced prostate cancer cell survival and heightened responsiveness to chemotherapy. This indicates that targeting SIRT6 could render prostate cancer cells more vulnerable to cytotoxic agents, supporting SIRT6 inhibition as an adjunct to prostate cancer treatment.
context.zh-TW: SIRT6的缺乏降低前列腺癌細胞的存活能力，同時增加化療敏感性。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於前列腺癌細胞存活降低和化療反應性增強的上游。這表明靶向SIRT6可能使前列腺癌細胞更容易受到細胞毒藥物的影響，支持SIRT6抑制作為前列腺癌治療的輔助手段。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT7
object: dependent on N- and C-terminal domains

context.en-US: The DNA-activated deacetylase activity of SIRT7 is dependent on both the N- and C-terminal domains. The SIRT7 N-terminal domain (NTD) is made up of three helices, and according to the findings SIRT7-NTD has structural similarities to transcription factor regulators and may have a role in DNA binding. Directionally, the SIRT7 NTD sits upstream of DNA binding and enzymatic activation, connecting SIRT7 structure to its chromatin-associated functions.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7的DNA活化去乙醯酶活性依賴於N端和C端結構域。SIRT7 N端結構域（NTD）由三條螺旋組成，根據研究結果，SIRT7-NTD與轉錄因子調節器具有結構相似性，可能在DNA結合中具有作用。方向上，SIRT7 NTD位於DNA結合和酵素活化的上游，將SIRT7結構與其染色質相關功能聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT7
object: aging and lifespan of hematopoietic cells

context.en-US: SIRT7 has deacetylase activity and plays a critical role in ageing and lifespan of hematopoietic cells in humans. SIRT7 is an influence factor in healthy aging and the development of age-dependent myeloid stem-cell disorders. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of haematopoietic stem cell maintenance and healthy aging, with dysregulation linked to age-dependent blood disorders.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7具有去乙醯酶活性，在人類造血細胞的老化和壽命中發揮關鍵作用。SIRT7是健康老化和年齡依賴性骨髓幹細胞疾病發展的影響因子。方向上，SIRT7位於造血幹細胞維護和健康老化的上游，其失調與年齡依賴性血液疾病相關。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT7

context.en-US: SIRT7 arginine methylation maintains energy balance by coordinating glucose availability with mitochondria biogenesis. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of the coupling between nutrient (glucose) status and mitochondrial mass. By linking glucose sensing to mitochondrial biogenesis, SIRT7 helps the cell match energy production to substrate availability, contributing to metabolic homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7精氨酸甲基化透過協調葡萄糖可用性與粒線體生成來維持能量平衡。方向上，SIRT7位於營養（葡萄糖）狀態與粒線體質量之間耦合的上游。透過將葡萄糖感知與粒線體生成聯繫起來，SIRT7幫助細胞使能量產生與底物可用性匹配，有助於代謝恆定。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT7

context.en-US: Sirtuin 7 is required not only for rDNA transcription but also for particular pre-rRNA cleavage. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of ribosomal RNA synthesis and processing in the nucleolus. By supporting both rDNA transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage, SIRT7 is essential for ribosome biogenesis, connecting SIRT7 to growth, protein synthesis, and cellular proliferation.
context.zh-TW: Sirtuin 7不僅是rDNA轉錄所必需的，也是特定pre-rRNA切割所必需的。方向上，SIRT7位於核仁中核糖體RNA合成和加工的上游。透過支持rDNA轉錄和pre-rRNA切割，SIRT7對核糖體生成至關重要，將SIRT7與生長、蛋白質合成和細胞增殖聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT7 depletion

context.en-US: SIRT7 depletion decreases DNA repair and compaction of chromatin, rendering cells more susceptible to genotoxic stressors. SIRT7 is a histone desuccinylase that functionally links to chromatin compaction and genome stability. Directionally, SIRT7 loss sits upstream of reduced genomic stability and increased sensitivity to DNA damage, making SIRT7 important for protecting cells against genotoxic stress.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7耗竭降低DNA修復和染色質壓縮，使細胞更容易受到基因毒性壓力源的影響。SIRT7是一種組蛋白去琥珀醯化酶，在功能上與染色質壓縮和基因組穩定性相關。方向上，SIRT7缺失位於基因組穩定性降低和DNA損傷敏感性增加的上游，使SIRT7對保護細胞免受基因毒性壓力至關重要。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT7
object: human stem cell aging as a heterochromatin stabilizer

context.en-US: SIRT7 antagonizes human stem cell aging as a heterochromatin stabiliser and safeguards chromatin structure. As a heterochromatin stabiliser, SIRT7 counteracts human stem cell ageing. SIRT7 also regulates innate immune modulation and ensures geroprotection during stem cell ageing. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of heterochromatin maintenance and stem cell rejuvenation, protecting stem cells from age-related chromatin deterioration.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7作為異染色質穩定劑對抗人類幹細胞老化並維護染色質結構。作為異染色質穩定劑，SIRT7對抗人類幹細胞老化。SIRT7也調節先天免疫調節並在幹細胞老化期間確保老年保護。方向上，SIRT7位於異染色質維護和幹細胞回春的上游，保護幹細胞免受與年齡相關的染色質惡化。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT7 inactivation

context.en-US: SIRT7 inactivation reduces breast cancer metastasis by blocking TGF-β signalling. SIRT7 deacetylase activity inhibits metastasis of breast cancer by antagonising transforming growth factor-β signalling. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of TGF-β-driven metastasis in breast cancer. By promoting TGF-β signalling, SIRT7 supports the metastatic spread of breast cancer cells, and its inactivation curbs this process regardless of changes in original tumour development.
context.zh-TW: SIRT7失活透過阻斷TGF-β訊號來減少乳腺癌轉移。SIRT7去乙醯酶活性透過拮抗轉化生長因子-β訊號來抑制乳腺癌轉移。方向上，SIRT7位於乳腺癌中TGF-β驅動的轉移的上游。透過促進TGF-β訊號，SIRT7支持乳腺癌細胞的轉移性擴散，其失活無論原始腫瘤發展的變化如何都限制了此過程。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT7
object: colorectal, gastric, and luminal breast cancer

context.en-US: In humans, SIRT7 takes part in the genesis of colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, and luminal breast cancer. SIRT7 is overexpressed in multiple cancer tissues, promoting the survival of cancer cells and the maintenance of a transformed state. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of tumorigenesis in these cancer types, and its overexpression supports the transformed phenotype across a broad range of tumours.
context.zh-TW: 在人類中，SIRT7參與大腸直腸癌、胃癌和管腔型乳腺癌的發生。SIRT7在多種癌症組織中過表達，促進癌細胞的存活和轉化狀態的維持。方向上，SIRT7位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤發生的上游，其過表達在廣泛的腫瘤中支持轉化表型。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: Butein, piceatannol and isoliquiritigenin

context.en-US: Plant polyphenols notably butein, piceatannol, and isoliquiritigenin (ILQ) have been demonstrated to activate recombinant SIRT1, and are known as sirtuin activating compounds (STACs). Directionally, these natural polyphenols sit upstream of enhanced SIRT1 enzymatic activity. Together with resveratrol, these plant-derived compounds represent natural STACs, and synthetic STACs such as SRT1720 activate SIRT1 substantially more potently.
context.zh-TW: 植物多酚中較為突出的成分，包括紫檀芪（piceatannol）、丁香酚（butein）和異甘草素（ILQ），已被證實能夠活化重組 SIRT1，並被歸類為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs）。從作用方向而言，這些天然多酚位於增強 SIRT1 酶活性的上游。與白藜蘆醇一起，這些植物來源的化合物代表了天然 STACs，而合成 STACs 如 SRT1720 活化 SIRT1 的效力則顯著更強。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: Resveratrol

context.en-US: Resveratrol (3, 5, 4'-trihydroxystilbene) is a natural plant polyphenol found in grapes and red wines. In lower organisms, resveratrol replicates the effects of calorie restriction, and mice fed a high-fat diet have lower insulin resistance. STACs interact directly with SIRT1 and other isoforms, and resveratrol remains the most prominent natural sirtuin activator with longevity-relevant effects.
context.zh-TW: 白藜蘆醇（3,5,4'-三羥基芪）是一種天然植物多酚，存在於葡萄和紅酒中。在低等生物中，白藜蘆醇能夠複製熱量限制的效果；餵食高脂飲食的小鼠在白藜蘆醇作用下胰島素抵抗降低。STACs 直接與 SIRT1 及其他亞型相互作用，而白藜蘆醇仍然是最具代表性的天然 sirtuin 活化劑，具有與壽命相關的效應。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SRT1720

context.en-US: Many synthetic STACs that are chemically unrelated to resveratrol, such as those with an imidazo[1,2-b]thiazole core including SRT1720, activate SIRT1 substantially more potently than resveratrol. Directionally, SRT1720 sits upstream of enhanced SIRT1 activity, with higher potency than natural activators. These synthetic activators have been used in numerous studies to demonstrate their effect on SIRT1 and are being developed for therapeutic applications.
context.zh-TW: 許多與白藜蘆醇在化學結構上不相關的合成 STACs，例如含有咪唑並[1,2-b]噻唑核心結構的 SRT1720，活化 SIRT1 的效力顯著高於白藜蘆醇。從作用方向而言，SRT1720 位於增強 SIRT1 活性的上游，其效力高於天然活化劑。這些合成活化劑已被用於大量研究中，以證明其對 SIRT1 的作用效果，目前正在開發用於治療應用。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: Splitomicin
object: Sir2 in S. cerevisiae (weakly inhibits human SIRT1)

context.en-US: Splitomicin inhibits Sir2 in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, but showed weaker inhibition on human SIRT1. Yeast Sir2 and human SIRT2 are inhibited by sirtinol. Directionally, these small-molecule sirtuin inhibitors (STICs) sit upstream of reduced sirtuin catalytic activity, with species- and isoform-selective potencies. Sirtuin inhibitors have also been considered for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, in addition to cancer therapy.
context.zh-TW: Splitomicin 抑制釀酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中的 Sir2，但對人類 SIRT1 的抑制作用較弱。酵母 Sir2 和人類 SIRT2 均可被 sirtinol 抑制。從作用方向而言，這些小分子 sirtuin 抑制劑（STICs）位於降低 sirtuin 催化活性的上游，具有物種和亞型選擇性效能。除了癌症治療之外，sirtuin 抑制劑也被考慮用於帕金森氏症的治療。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: Suramin

context.en-US: Suramin is a potent inhibitor of many sirtuins like SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT5. The majority of known sirtuin inhibitors exclusively inhibit SIRT1 and/or SIRT2, however some also inhibit SIRT3 and SIRT5 with reduced affinity. Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines, and Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53, with both inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2.
context.zh-TW: 蘇拉明（Suramin）是多種 sirtuins 的強效抑制劑，包括 SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT5。大多數已知的 sirtuin 抑制劑僅抑制 SIRT1 和/或 SIRT2，但也有部分抑制劑以較低親和力抑制 SIRT3 和 SIRT5。Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用，而 Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡，兩者均可抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: Cambinol

context.en-US: Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines. Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53. Both Cambinol and Salermide have inhibitory effects on SIRT1 and SIRT2. Directionally, these sirtuin-inhibiting compounds sit upstream of suppressed cancer cell growth, with Cambinol showing particular potency against Burkitt lymphoma among the STIC class of sirtuin inhibitors.
context.zh-TW: Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用。Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡。Cambinol 和 Salermide 均對 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 具有抑制作用。從作用方向而言，這些 sirtuin 抑制化合物位於抑制癌細胞生長的上游，其中 Cambinol 在 STIC 類 sirtuin 抑制劑中對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤表現出特別的效力。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT1 and SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT1 and SIRT2 promote cell proliferation and play a pro-tumorigenic role in lung cancer. Expression of sirtuin 1 and 2 is associated with poor prognosis in non-small cell lung cancer patients. Directionally, SIRT1 and SIRT2 sit upstream of lung cancer cell proliferation and aggressive disease. Their elevated expression is linked to poor prognosis, supporting SIRT1 and SIRT2 as therapeutic targets and prognostic biomarkers in lung cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 和 SIRT2 促進細胞增殖並在肺癌中發揮促腫瘤作用。Sirtuin 1 和 2 的表達與非小細胞肺癌患者的不良預後相關。從作用方向而言，SIRT1 和 SIRT2 位於肺癌細胞增殖和侵襲性疾病的上游。其表達上調與不良預後相關，支持 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 作為肺癌的治療靶點和預後生物標記。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT3 deficiency
object: colon cancer cell proliferation, invasion, and migration

context.en-US: In colon cancer, SIRT3 deficiency reduces cell proliferation, invasion, and migration while increasing apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT3 loss sits upstream of restrained colon cancer aggressiveness and enhanced cell death. SIRT3 could also be used as a marker for colon cancer. These findings indicate that SIRT3 supports the aggressive behaviour of colon cancer cells, and its inhibition may represent an anti-tumour strategy.
context.zh-TW: 在結腸癌中，SIRT3 缺乏可減少細胞增殖、侵襲和遷移，同時增加細胞凋亡。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 的缺失位於抑制結腸癌侵襲性和增強細胞死亡的上游。SIRT3 也可作為結腸癌的標記物。這些發現表明 SIRT3 支持結腸癌細胞的侵襲性行為，其抑制可能代表一種抗腫瘤策略。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT3 upregulation
object: glycolysis and proliferation in breast cancer cells

context.en-US: Upregulation of SIRT3 in breast cancer cells suppresses glycolysis and proliferation, offering a metabolic pathway for tumour suppression. Directionally, SIRT3 sits upstream of reduced glycolytic metabolism and growth in breast cancer cells. By suppressing glycolysis, SIRT3 limits the Warburg-like metabolic program that supports breast cancer proliferation, identifying SIRT3 activation as a potential tumour-suppressive strategy in breast cancer.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 在乳腺癌細胞中的上調可抑制糖酵解和細胞增殖，為腫瘤抑制提供了一條代謝途徑。從作用方向而言，SIRT3 位於降低乳腺癌細胞糖酵解代謝和生長的上游。透過抑制糖酵解，SIRT3 限制了支持乳腺癌增殖的類沃伯格（Warburg）代謝程序，從而確立 SIRT3 活化作為乳腺癌中潛在的腫瘤抑制策略。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 is found to be overexpressed in Parkinson's disease. SIRT2 is also overexpressed in neurodegenerative disorders generally and protects neural cells from oxidative damage caused by ageing and disease. Directionally, elevated SIRT2 sits upstream of neurodegeneration in Parkinson's disease. Sirtuin inhibitors have been considered for the treatment of Parkinson's disease, alongside cancer therapy, because of this SIRT2 involvement.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 被發現在帕金森氏症中過度表達。SIRT2 在神經退行性疾病中也普遍過度表達，並保護神經細胞免受衰老和疾病引起的氧化損傷。從作用方向而言，SIRT2 的升高位於帕金森氏症神經退行性變的上游。由於 SIRT2 的這種參與，sirtuin 抑制劑已被考慮用於帕金森氏症的治療以及癌症治療。

source_document: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md

subject: Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis
object: aging results from progressive loss of epigenetic information

context.en-US: The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a key framework in aging biology, primarily developed by David Sinclair and colleagues. It proposes that aging in eukaryotes results largely from the progressive loss of epigenetic information due to the repeated relocalization of chromatin-modifying proteins during DNA repair. Chromatin modifiers normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain gene expression patterns that define cell identity, but are recruited to damage sites during repair, temporarily disrupting their original positions and altering local gene expression.
context.zh-TW: 染色質修飾因子再定位（RCM）假說是衰老生物學中的關鍵框架，主要由 David Sinclair 及其同事發展。該假說提出，真核生物的衰老主要源於表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失，這是因為在 DNA 修復過程中染色質修飾蛋白質反覆再定位所致。染色質修飾因子通常定位於特定的基因組位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表達模式，但在修復期間被招募到損傷位點，暫時破壞其原始位置並改變局部基因表達。

source_document: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

subject: Chromatin modifiers (SIRT1, SIRT6, HDAC1, PARP1)

context.en-US: Chromatin modifiers including sirtuins like SIRT1 and SIRT6, as well as HDAC1 and PARP1, normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain proper gene expression patterns that define cell identity. When DNA damage, especially double-strand breaks, occurs, these proteins are recruited to damage sites to assist in repair. This temporarily disrupts their original positions, altering local gene expression, and repeated relocalization over a lifetime contributes to the progressive loss of epigenetic information.
context.zh-TW: 包括 SIRT1 和 SIRT6 等 sirtuins 在內的染色質修飾因子，以及 HDAC1 和 PARP1，通常位於特定的基因組位點以維持定義細胞身分的正確基因表達模式。當 DNA 損傷（特別是雙股斷裂）發生時，這些蛋白質被招募到損傷位點以協助修復。這暫時破壞了它們的原始位置，改變局部基因表達，而在一生中反覆的再定位則導致表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失。

source_document: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

subject: RCM (Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers)

context.en-US: RCM likely evolved as a beneficial short-term response: relocalizing modifiers to damage sites helps cells survive acute threats by prioritizing repair and survival over normal gene regulation. In youth this is advantageous, but over a lifetime the cumulative failure to reset becomes detrimental, contributing to aging. This trade-off, where a trait that benefits early survival becomes harmful later in life, is the classic signature of antagonistic pleiotropy.
context.zh-TW: RCM 可能作為有益的短期反應演化而來：將修飾因子再定位到損傷位點有助於細胞透過優先進行修復和存活來應對急性威脅，而非維持正常的基因調控。在年輕時這是有利的，但在一生中累積的重置失敗會變得有害，從而促成衰老。這種在早期生存有益但在晚年有害的權衡特徵，正是拮抗多效性的經典標誌。

source_document: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

subject: Partial reprogramming

context.en-US: Partial reprogramming (e.g., via Yamanaka factors) can reset epigenetic information, supporting the idea that aging is reversible at the information level. This connection to cellular reprogramming complements the RCM hypothesis, which frames aging as an epigenetic software problem rather than purely hardware (mutation) damage. Because epigenetic changes can potentially be reset, unlike permanent mutations, reprogramming-based approaches offer a route to restoring youthful gene expression patterns.
context.zh-TW: 部分重編程（例如透過 Yamanaka 因子）可以重置表觀遺傳資訊，支持了衰老在資訊層面可逆的觀點。這種與細胞重編程的關聯補充了 RCM 假說，該假說將衰老定位為表觀遺傳軟體問題，而非單純的硬體（突變）損傷。由於表觀遺傳變化不像永久性突變那樣無法逆轉，基於重編程的方法提供了恢復年輕基因表達模式的途徑。

source_document: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

subject: DSB repair and RCM

context.en-US: DSB repair and RCM may advance epigenetic clocks by affecting DNA methylation machinery (e.g., TET enzymes and DNMTs). Because the response to DNA damage follows conserved mechanisms, aging becomes somewhat predictable despite random damage, leading to consistent epigenetic drift. Directionally, DNA damage repair and the consequent relocalization of chromatin modifiers sit upstream of clock-measured epigenetic age acceleration, linking RCM to quantitative measures of biological aging.
context.zh-TW: 雙股斷裂（DSB）修復和 RCM 可能透過影響 DNA 甲基化機制（例如 TET 酶和 DNMTs）來推進表觀遺傳時鐘。由於 DNA 損傷反應遵循保守的機制，衰老因此具有一定的可預測性，儘管損傷是隨機的，導致一致的表觀遺傳漂移。從作用方向而言，DNA 損傷修復及隨後的染色質修飾因子再定位位於時鐘測量的表觀遺傳年齡加速的上游，將 RCM 與生物衰老的量化測量聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates α-tubulin (alongside SIRT2), contributing to cytoskeletal/microtubule regulation and cytoplasmic deacetylase activity.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 α-tubulin（與 SIRT2 協同），有助於細胞骨架/微管調控和細胞質去乙醯酶活性。

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates and cooperates with the H3K9 methyltransferase Suv39h1 to enforce heterochromatin and silencing.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並與 H3K9 甲基轉移酶 Suv39h1 協同作用，以強化異染色質和基因沉默。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates N-Myc, modulating its stability/transcriptional output in proliferation and tumor contexts.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 N-Myc，調節其在增殖和腫瘤環境中的穩定性/轉錄活性。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates estrogen receptor α, influencing estrogen-responsive transcription in metabolic and cancer contexts.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化雌激素受體 α，在代謝和癌症環境中影響雌激素反應性轉錄。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: Through deacetylation, SIRT1 activates SIRT6, linking NAD+ sensing to chromatin, DNA repair, antioxidant defense, and metabolic regulation.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化作用活化 SIRT6，將 NAD+ 感知與染色質、DNA 修復、抗氧化防禦和代謝調控聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 upregulates ADAM-10 (α-secretase), shifting APP processing away from amyloid-β and protecting against Alzheimer's pathology.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 上調 ADAM-10（α-secretase），將 APP 處理過程從類澱粉 β 方向轉移，從而預防阿茲海默症的病理變化。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates NBS1 (MRE11 complex), facilitating DNA double-strand-break sensing/repair.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 NBS1（MRE11 複合體），促進 DNA 雙股斷裂的感測/修復。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates XPA, a core nucleotide-excision-repair factor, enhancing DNA-damage recognition.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化 XPA（核苷酸切除修復的核心因子），增強 DNA 損傷的辨識能力。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates MnSOD (SOD2), enhancing mitochondrial ROS detoxification and stress resistance.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 MnSOD（SOD2），增強粒線體活性氧（ROS）解毒和抗壓能力。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates the Werner syndrome helicase WRN, linking SIRT1 to DNA repair and genomic stability.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 Werner 氏症候群解旋酶 WRN，將 SIRT1 與 DNA 修復和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 activates FOXO1/FOXO3 by deacetylation, coupling NAD+ sensing to stress resistance and metabolic gene programs (Brunet 2004 PMID 15066266).
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化作用活化 FOXO1/FOXO3，將 NAD+ 感知與抗壓反應和代謝基因程序耦合（Brunet 2004 PMID 15066266）。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 deacetylates/activates PPARα, promoting fatty-acid oxidation and lipid homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 去乙醯化/活化 PPARα，促進脂肪酸氧化和脂質恆定。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 regulates the bile-acid receptor FXR, linking NAD+ status to cholesterol and metabolic homeostasis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 調節膽汁酸受體 FXR，將 NAD+ 狀態與膽固醇和代謝恆定聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 inhibits the coactivator p300 by deacetylation, dampening p300-dependent transcriptional programs.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化作用抑制共活化因子 p300，減弱 p300 依賴性的轉錄程序。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 inhibits p66Shc, a lifespan-associated redox adapter: SIRT1 represses p66Shc transcription (SIRT1 knockdown raises p66Shc), and p66Shc elevation promotes reactive-oxygen-species generation and endothelial dysfunction, contributing to SIRT1 decline and vascular aging (Zhou et al., 2011, PMID 21778425). By keeping p66Shc low, SIRT1 reduces oxidative stress and age-related damage.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 抑制 p66Shc（一種與壽命相關的氧化還原接頭蛋白）：SIRT1 抑制 p66Shc 的轉錄（SIRT1 下調會增加 p66Shc），而 p66Shc 的升高促進活性氧生成和內皮功能障礙，參與 SIRT1 下降和血管衰老（Zhou et al., 2011, PMID 21778425）。透過維持低水平的 p66Shc，SIRT1 減少氧化壓力和年齡相關的損傷。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 restrains mTOR signaling indirectly (via AMPK/energy sensing), opposing growth/hypertrophic programs.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過 AMPK/能量感知間接地抑制 mTOR 信號，對抗生長/肥大程序。

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 suppresses TNF-α production/ signaling downstream of NF-κB deacetylation, blunting inflammation.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 在 NF-κB 去乙醯化的下游抑制 TNF-α 的產生/信號傳導，減輕發炎反應。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 removes acetyl groups from histones, promoting a repressive/condensed chromatin state at target loci.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 移除組蛋白上的乙醯基團，促進靶位點的抑制性/凝縮染色質狀態。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 inhibits SREBP-1c (lipogenesis) via deacetylation of ChREBP/SREBP and LXR pathways, reducing fatty-acid synthesis.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 ChREBP/SREBP 和 LXR 通路抑制 SREBP-1c（脂肪生成），減少脂肪酸合成。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 governs glucose metabolism by deacetylating FOXO1, PGC-1alpha, and CRTC2 to promote gluconeogenic and oxidative programs, downregulates PTP1B to improve insulin sensitivity, and represses UCP2 in pancreatic beta-cells to support glucose-stimulated insulin secretion. SIRT1 is central to glucose homeostasis and to the insulin-sensitizing effects of caloric restriction.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 FOXO1、PGC-1alpha 和 CRTC2 來調控葡萄糖代謝，促進糖質新生和氧化程序；下調 PTP1B 以改善胰島素敏感性；並抑制胰腺 β 細胞中的 UCP2 以支持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌。SIRT1 是葡萄糖恆定和熱量限制胰島素增敏效應的核心。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 promotes fatty-acid metabolism by deacetylating and activating PGC-1alpha and PPARalpha to drive fatty-acid oxidation, represses lipogenesis via SREBP-1c, and mobilizes fat from white adipose tissue by repressing PPAR-gamma and aP2. This supports metabolic flexibility and the lean phenotype of caloric restriction.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並活化 PGC-1alpha 和 PPARalpha 來促進脂肪酸氧化，透過 SREBP-1c 抑制脂肪生成，並透過抑制 PPAR-gamma 和 aP2 從白色脂肪組織中動員脂肪。這支持了代謝靈活性和熱量限制的精瘦表型。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 regulates cholesterol metabolism by deacetylating LXR and modulating hepatic lipid-gene programs, supporting reverse cholesterol transport and lipid homeostasis; its actions on bile-acid (FXR) and cholesterol (SREBP) pathways contribute to cardiovascular protection.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 LXR 和調節肝臟脂質基因程序來調控膽固醇代謝，支持反向膽固醇運輸和脂質恆定；其對膽汁酸（FXR）和膽固醇（SREBP）通路的作用有助於心血管保護。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 controls differentiation in a lineage-dependent manner: it inhibits myogenesis by deacetylating PCAF and MyoD and repressing myogenin, while promoting osteoblast differentiation over adipogenesis by repressing PPAR-gamma and supporting RUNX2. This reflects SIRT1's context-specific role in cell-fate decisions.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 以譜系依賴的方式控制分化：它透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 並抑制 myogenin 來抑制肌生成，同時透過抑制 PPAR-gamma 並支持 RUNX2 來促進成骨細胞分化而非脂肪生成。這反映了 SIRT1 在細胞命運決定中的環境特異性角色。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 supports glucose-stimulated insulin secretion by transcriptionally repressing UCP2 in pancreatic beta-cells, preserving mitochondrial membrane potential and ATP synthesis; beta-cell SIRT1 overexpression enhances, while SIRT1 loss impairs, the insulin response, linking SIRT1 to beta-cell function and diabetes.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過轉錄抑制胰腺 β 細胞中的 UCP2 來支持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌，維持粒線體膜電位和 ATP 合成；β 細胞 SIRT1 過表達可增強胰島素反應，而 SIRT1 缺失則損害胰島素反應，將 SIRT1 與 β 細胞功能和糖尿病聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 confers neuroprotection by deacetylating FOXO and PGC-1alpha to drive antioxidant and mitochondrial programs, suppressing NF-kB-mediated neuroinflammation, and promoting non-amyloidogenic APP processing via ADAM10; it protects against beta-amyloid toxicity and supports BDNF expression through Hes1 deacetylation.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 FOXO 和 PGC-1alpha 來驅動抗氧化和粒線體程序，抑制 NF-kB 介導的神經發炎反應，並透過 ADAM10 促進非類澱粉樣 APP 處理，從而賦予神經保護作用；它保護免受 β-類澱粉毒性並透過 Hes1 去乙醯化支持 BDNF 表達。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 is a central stress-response integrator that deacetylates p53, FOXO, NF-kB, and HIF to bias cells toward repair and survival, activates Nrf2 and antioxidant enzymes, and relocalizes to DNA-damage sites to support repair; these actions underpin SIRT1's stress resistance and longevity functions.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 是一個核心的壓力反應整合因子，它去乙醯化 p53、FOXO、NF-kB 和 HIF，使細胞偏向修復和存活方向；活化 Nrf2 和抗氧化酶；並再定位至 DNA 損傷位點以支持修復；這些作用構成了 SIRT1 抗壓能力和長壽功能的基礎。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT1

context.en-US: SIRT1 protects the vasculature by deacetylating and activating eNOS to boost nitric oxide, downregulating AT1R and NF-kB, maintaining TIMP3, and suppressing foam-cell formation via Lox-1; endothelial SIRT1 depletion is associated with cardiovascular disease, and SIRT1 activation opposes atherosclerosis and vascular aging.
context.zh-TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並活化 eNOS 來增強一氧化氮生成，下調 AT1R 和 NF-kB，維持 TIMP3，並透過 Lox-1 抑制泡沫細胞形成，從而保護血管；內皮 SIRT1 缺乏與心血管疾病相關，而 SIRT1 活化可對抗動脈粥狀硬化和血管衰老。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 deacetylates H3K56ac, contributing to mitotic chromatin organization and genome stability.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化 H3K56ac，有助於有絲分裂染色質組織和基因組穩定性。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 deacetylates histone H4 Lys16 during the G2/M transition, promoting mitotic chromatin condensation (Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462).
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期間去乙醯化組蛋白 H4 Lys16，促進有絲分裂染色質凝縮（Vaquero et al., 2006, Genes Dev 20:1256-1261, PMID 16648462）。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 activates FOXO via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 FOXO（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 activates c-Myc via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 c-Myc（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 activates G6PD via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 G6PD（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 activates PEPCK via deacetylation (e.g., FOXO, c-Myc, G6PD, PEPCK), influencing transcription, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, and redox balance.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化活化 PEPCK（例如 FOXO、c-Myc、G6PD、PEPCK），影響轉錄、糖酵解/糖質新生和氧化還原平衡。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 inhibits p53 by deacetylation (e.g., NF-κB, p53, FOXO1), generally restraining their transcriptional/apoptotic output.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化抑制 p53（例如 NF-κB、p53、FOXO1），通常抑制其轉錄/凋亡輸出。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 inhibits FOXO1 by deacetylation (e.g., NF-κB, p53, FOXO1), generally restraining their transcriptional/apoptotic output.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化抑制 FOXO1（例如 NF-κB、p53、FOXO1），通常抑制其轉錄/凋亡輸出。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 peaks at the G2/M transition and deacetylates H4K16, alpha-tubulin, and mitotic regulators, promoting chromatin condensation and mitotic fidelity; its loss raises Aurora-A/B and causes aneuploidy, linking SIRT2 to cell-cycle control and genomic stability.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 在 G2/M 轉換期達到高峰，並去乙醯化 H4K16、α-tubulin 和有絲分裂調節因子，促進染色質凝縮和有絲分裂忠實度；其缺失會增加 Aurora-A/B 水平並導致非整倍體，將 SIRT2 與細胞週期控制和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 regulates carbohydrate metabolism by deacetylating G6PD (pentose phosphate pathway) and phosphoglycerate mutase (glycolysis) to influence NADPH production and glucose flux, and deacetylates PEPCK to support gluconeogenesis; these actions link SIRT2 to redox balance and metabolic control.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化 G6PD（磷酸戊糖途徑）和磷酸甘油酸變位酶（糖酵解）來調節碳水化合物代謝，影響 NADPH 產生和葡萄糖通量；並去乙醯化 PEPCK 以支持糖質新生；這些作用將 SIRT2 與氧化還原平衡和代謝控制聯繫起來。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 prevents hepatic steatosis by deacetylating HNF4alpha, a master regulator of hepatic lipid genes, and suppresses adipocyte differentiation via FoxO1 deacetylation that restrains PPAR-gamma; reduced SIRT2 in obese adipose progenitors is linked to visceral fat expansion.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 透過去乙醯化肝臟脂質基因的主調控因子 HNF4α 來預防肝脂肪變性，並透過 FoxO1 去乙醯化抑制脂肪細胞分化（FoxO1 去乙醯化可抑制 PPAR-γ）；肥胖脂肪前體細胞中 SIRT2 的減少與內臟脂肪擴增相關。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2

context.en-US: SIRT2 is the first identified tubulin deacetylase, removing acetyl groups from alpha-tubulin to regulate microtubule stability and dynamics; this underlies SIRT2's mitotic roles and explains why SIRT2 inhibitors, by preserving tubulin acetylation, protect neurons in Parkinson's and Huntington's disease models.
context.zh-TW: SIRT2 是第一個被發現的 tubulin 去乙醯酶，它移除 α-tubulin 上的乙醯基團以調節微管穩定性和動態性；這構成了 SIRT2 有絲分裂功能的基礎，也解釋了為什麼 SIRT2 抑制劑透過保留 tubulin 乙醯化，在帕金森氏症和亨廷頓氏症模型中保護神經元。

source_document: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md

subject: SIRT2
